properties.Label: ESB Sales Order Flag
properties.Description: Indicates the sales order information has been sent to the SOA Business Information Service

properties.Label: ESB Shipment Flag
properties.Description: Indicates the shipping information has been sent to the SOA Business Information Service

properties.Label: Ext Shipping Instructions
properties.Description: Extended shipping instructions. The extended shipping instructions will print on the pick ticket.

properties.Label: Invoice To
properties.Description: The customer that is floor planning the order. This is the customer that will be invoiced during invoice processing, but the customer (custno) will be shipped the goods. Content:

properties.Label: Freight Terms
properties.Description: Freight Terms Content:

properties.Label: Fulfillment Billing Code
properties.Description: Determines when a Fulfillment Order is ready to be billed through Consolidated Invoicing. When OERC is run, it looks at all the fulfillment orders submitted and looks at the Tied Order stock status to see if the billing setting has been met. If an order is set to Manually Release, the means someone is forcing the order through Consolidated Invoicing and they manually set the code through OEIF. Once an order has been validated based on the Quantity Ship status of the tied orders, the oeeh.fulfillmentstgcd is set to 'R'eleased. OERC will pick up the 'R'eleased and 'M'anually released fulfillment stage orders Content:

properties.Label: Fulfillment Order
properties.Description: Is the order an original order fulfillment order. The order that all the items were placed on before stock orders are created from the warehouses selected to fulfill the order. It will always be a Blanket Order (BL). This allows for no affect on the inventory in the system. This order will also be used in Consolidated Invoicing for billing of one invoice based on all the Tied Fulfillment Orders created from the original Fulfillment Order Content:

properties.Label: Fulfillment Order #
properties.Help: Tied Fulfillment Order Created From This Order #
properties.Description: When a Tied Fulfillment Order is created (oeeh.fulfillmenttiedfl = yes) from a Fulfillment Order (oeeh.fulfillmentordfl = yes) during the 'Submit' process, the order that the Tied Fulfillment Order is created from is stored on the tied order. Content:

properties.Label: Fulfillment Stage
properties.Description: This will track the stage of the Fulfillment Order. From the time it is initially entered to the point of being ready to invoice through Consolidated Invoicing. If the system it set to not do fulfillment billing through consolidated invoicing, then the only stages that are used in the sustem are Open, eCommerce and Submitted. OERC will look at Tied Order associated with Fulfillment orders in stage Submitted, Released and Consolidated. Content:

properties.Label: Tied Fulfillment Order
properties.Description: Tied Fulfillment Order are created from the original Fulfillment Order once the operator selects the Warehouses or Ties to be used to fill the line items and Submit is choosen from OEET, OEIF, or SXAPI Full Order Maint (based on OESF SXAPI Auto Submit option setting). If a Stock Order is tied to a Fulfillment Order (Created from it), then the tied flag is set. The only tie to the fulfillment order is through the OEELO record that is attached to the original fulfillment order - showing what Tied Fulfillment Orders are associated with the fulfillment order. Once the Tied Order is created, the Tied Order shows the original fulfillment order it came from by looking at the fulfillment orderno/oordersuf fields. Content:

properties.Label: Geo Code
properties.Description: Taxware Sales and Use Tax (SUT) uses the geo code to determine which taxes should be applied if there is more than one taxing jurisdiction within a zip code. Examples of this are when a zip code crosses county lines and each county has a different tax rate or when multiple cities exist in the same zip code and each city has a different tax rate. Each taxing jurisdiction within the zip code is given a unique, two-digit identifier. Taxware uses the city name, state, zip code and geo code to find the correct tax rates. Taxware Enterprise (TWE) uses the geo code as a unique identifier of a taxing jurisdiction and not a supplemental identifier as in SUT. With TWE, all jusrisdictions world-wide have a geo code. Each geo code can include country, state or province, county, city and district taxing jurisdictions. Any taxing jurisdiction except country can be omitted from the definition of a geo code. TWE can apply the correct tax rates based on the geo code alone. Content:

properties.Label: G.S.T. Type
properties.Description: This represents the GST taxable type of the order. This is used for Canadian taxes only. Content:

properties.Label: Freight In
properties.Description: The in bound freight flag is loaded from the customer record. It indicates whether we require in bound freight to be passed on to the customer. In bound freight is positionally located in the first addon field. If the in bound freight flag is yes and the first addon amount is 0, the order will not be invoiced. Content:

properties.Label: # of Invoices Printed
properties.Description: The number of times the invoice was printed. It is increased from a demand print (OEETG or OERD) and from OEEPI.

properties.Label: Invoice#
properties.Description: On an RM or CR, the invoice to return against. If an invoice number is entered, it must be an active invoice in ARET. When this order is invoiced, a credit is created against the entered invoice number. NOTE: This is NOT the invoice number of this order. The order number always equates to the invoice number of this particular order.

properties.Label: Invoice
properties.Description: The date the order was invoiced.
For a CR or RM, the invoice suffix this order should be applied against. When this order is invoiced, a credit is created against the invno/invsuf in ARET. Content:

properties.Label: Line Refer
properties.Description: The job number as it relates to the ship to entered on the order. This field provides a default to the line level job number. Content:

properties.Label: Jrnl #
properties.Description: The journal used when the order is tendered. This is an OEET journal.

properties.Label: Inv Proc Jrnl
properties.Description: The journal used when the order is invoiced. This is an OEEPI journal.

properties.Label: Shipping Journal
properties.Help: Automated Journal Posting for Addons in OE Shipping
properties.Description: This journal is reserved for automatic tendering that is controlled from OEES - Shipping Feedback processing. It is used to automatically adjust for addons added during OEES and if there are already Credit Card postings done against the order. There are other factors that apply as well, but this field is reserved for the 'OEES' journal.

properties.Label: Word Index
properties.Description: Internal field used for keyword processing Content:

properties.Label: Language
properties.Description: The language code that describes the language for the customer. Content:

properties.Label: Lines Altered
properties.Description: Indicates that the order needs to be totalled. Totalled means the following: the special order discount needs to be calculated the addons need to be calculated the taxes need to be calculated the whole order discount needs to be calculated the customer on order balance needs to be updated. Totalling occurs in p-oetot.i

properties.Label: Lock Prices
properties.Description: Indicates the prices on a ST or FO are locked. If the prices are locked, they will not be reset when the order is converted. Content:

properties.Label: Lead Time
properties.Description: The longest lead time of all the products on the order - represented in days. This field is updated from the average lead time of each line item on all order types. (The average lead time for a non-stock product will be determined from the ICSL lead time if the non-stock product has a vendor/line ARP.) This field is used to back up the correct number of days in order to convert a FO or BR on time based on the promise date of the order. NOTE: As of the 5.1 release, the lead time is now enterable on the line item. It defaults as above, but can be changed. Content:

properties.Label: Lost Business Reason
properties.Description: The lost business reason if the order is manually cancelled. It is enterable by the operator when the order is cancelled and is validated against the SASTT Lost Business Reasons (E).

properties.Label: Lump Bill Amount
properties.Description: The lump bill amount is enterable on either a BL or BR to override the billing amount to the customer. If each suffix should be billed a fixed rate regardless of the delivery of products on each release, the lump bill amount should be used. The invoice in ARET will be created for the lump bill amount when the order is invoiced.

properties.Label: Lump Sum Bill
properties.Description: Indicates if the lump billing amount should be used when invoicing the customer. The flag allows the flexibility to invoice the customer a 0 amount on a particular invoice. Content:

properties.Label: Print Lump Prices
properties.Description: Indicates that lump bill prices should be printed on the invoice. Content:

properties.Label: Actual Manufacturer Shipment
properties.Description: Used to track when the Manufacturer (Vendor) actually shipped the order to the customer. Used to track on time deliveries to the customer or not. Distributor still wants to make sure the venfor is making ontime deliveries to the distributor's customers Informational Only. In place for Birst Reporting Content:

properties.Label: Manufacturer Customer Row Pointer
properties.Description: This is the Manufacturer (Vendor) linked to a customer record. This customer is used as the floor plan customer of the order. Or the actual floor plan customer on the Manufacturer Customer record (if using a corporate level company billing for the vendor) See arsc 'man' fields Content:

properties.Label: Calculate Sales Rep Commission From
properties.Description: A distributor may elect to pay a portion of the Manufacturer Commisison paid to the distributor with the sales reps on the Manufacturer Rep Orders. During SMRC when the commission is determined for the sales reps of the orders, this option will determine on the Man rep Orders how the rate is applied. Against the Sales Amount of the lines (netamt) or the Commission Amount paid to the distributor from the vendor. The value is pulled in from the ARSC Manufacturer Vendor customer setting, but loaded on the order for use in SMRC and commission to the sales reps Content:

properties.Label: Expected Commission Payment
properties.Description: When is the Vendor expected to make payment of the commission for this order. Compared against the actual Paid date of the order. Initially calculated off the Request Ship Date and the Manufacturer Customer terms setting (Req Ship Date + Due Date) Once the Actual Manufacturer Shipment Date (oeeh.manactshipdt) is entered by the operator, then the date is recalcuated based on the Terms of the Manufacture Sales Customer (Terms Due Date + Expected Ship Date) Informational Only. In place for Birst Reporting Content:

properties.Label: Manufacturer Order Type
properties.Description: New type of order in OE - Manufacture Rep Order. Will be an order that strictly tracks Sales and Commission payment from the Manufacturer Vendor. This are orders that mirror the orders in the vendors system. No inventory shipped to the customer since the vendor is billing the customer and shipping the goods to the customer The vendor is giving the distributor a commission for sending them the sale A total sales order only tracks a total commissopn amount and a total sales amount. The distributor only knows those totals and ntohgin about the actual orders in the vendor's system - no items. A commission check was sent with only those totals and the order did not exist in CSD with specifics of the order Content:

properties.Label: Manufacturer Order Status
properties.Description: Manufacturer Rep Orders only. No entry into the field. Informational only. In place for Birst Reporting System sets the different stages of the orders automatically. Ordered - when the order is entered in OEET Shipped - when the operator manually sets the Actual Manufacturer Ship Dt Paid - when cash receipts pays the order (oeeh.stagecd/oeeh.paiddt) Content:

properties.Label: Manual Zone Flag
properties.Help: Indicates if zone was entered manually by the shipper

properties.Label: Next Line #
properties.Description: The line number for the next line item to be entered. Content:

properties.Label: # Cat Wt
properties.Description: The number of line items for which catch weight quantities need to be entered. This field is automatically updated as line items are maintained. For each line that has a quantity shipped > 0 and the charge quantity has not yet be entered, this field will accumulate a value of 1. An order can not be invoiced until the charge quantity has been entered on all lines that require entry of a charge quantity. NOTE: We no longer allow entry of a "c" (catch weight) special costing type in ICSP. This field is currently not used. We do have plans to reinstate charge quantity functionality in OE in the future.

properties.Label: # DO Lines
properties.Description: The number of direct order lines on the order. This field is accumulated for each line with a "d" in the botype. If the number of DO lines on the order is equal to the number of lines on the order, the order can be set to shipped stage when filled from back order fill (and the unfilled lines will back order). If the nodolines is not equal to nolineitem, then the DO lines will be moved to a new suffix and filled (from back order fill). Content:

properties.Label: Allow For Our Records Only Invoice

properties.Description: The number of lines items on the order. It is accumulated as each line is added. If a line is deleted, the number is decremented. Content:

properties.Label: # Lines Not BO
properties.Description: The number of lines on the order that will not be back ordered.

properties.Label: # Packages
properties.Description: The number of packages tied to this order. This fields is updated from PM. Cartonization uses Carton ID's and not pacakge numbers, thus no corolation to OEEHP at the moment (5/21/20) Content:

properties.Label: # Rush Ln
properties.Description: The number of rush lines the are on the order. This field is incremented as rush lines are added or a line is change to/from a rush line. It is updated in a-oeetlt.i. Content:

properties.Label: # SN/Lots

properties.Label: Open Initials
properties.Description: The operator that is currently working on the order. This field is used to soft lock the order. When entry or maintenance is performed on an order, the openinit is loaded with the current operator. When the operator closes the order, the openinit is cleared. This prevents 2 operators from working on the same order at the same time. We employ soft locking since we are not in a transaction state the entire time an order is entered due to potential lock table overflow problems and length of record lock problems. Content:

properties.Label: Last Change By
properties.Description: Tags the record with the login initials of the last operator to update the record. Last update is defined by the operator pressing GO on a setup screen, or by the completion of a transaction in a batch updating process.

properties.Label: Order #
properties.Description: The order number of the order. This is the primary key. The formatting allows for 8 digits but the software has been enhanced to allow for 9 digits. Whenever this field is printed a larger format string must be used to avoid Progress errors.

properties.Label: Order Rep 1 Percent
properties.Description: This field stores an additional order rep percentage that can be assigned to an order. Setups in ARSC will copy to ARSS on a copy and can use the AO logic to copy to ARSS if ARSC is changed (SXE-2803). When an order is created, OEEH defaults from ARSC/ARSS and then OEEL defaults from OEEH. The operator can update the assignments in OEEH/OEEL for individual order/line specifics. Once the data is stored in the OEEH/OEEL records in the database, it will be sent to DataLake and any analysis/calculations (usually for commissions) against these fields will be done in Birst. There are five of these fields that can be used. Note that the field number must match to the ordrep field number, i.e., if ordrep2 is assigned a value and you want a percentage related to that, the percentage must be specified in orderreppct2, the 2 must match on both fields to correlate them. Added with JIRA SXE-3048/SXWEB-38216. Content:

This will default as false when an order is created, and set to true in the Order Finish logic as the user is only allowed to change the originalpromisedt when an order is new. Content:

properties.Label: Freight Out
properties.Description: The out bound freight flag indicates that out bound freight on this order is required. It initially defaults from the customer record. If this flag is set to yes, addon 2 is required prior to invoicing the order. Content:

properties.Label: Outside City Limit
properties.Description: Out of city limits indicator flag. Used by Taxware Enterprise (TWE) to indicate if the city is out of city limits for tax purposes Content:

properties.Label: Paid
properties.Description: The date the order was paid. This is update from ARECE when the last payment is received for this order.

properties.Label: Pay Amount
properties.Description: The payment made on the order. NOTE: This field is no longer used.

properties.Label: # Pick Tickets Printed
properties.Description: The number of times the pick ticket has been printed. This field is incremented each time a pick ticket is printed for the order.

properties.Label: Picked
properties.Description: The date the pick ticket was last printed.

properties.Label: Picked Time
properties.Description: The time the pick ticket was last printed.

properties.Label: Pick Init
properties.Description: The operator that last printed this pick ticket through OEEPP or the demand print (OEETG). Content:

properties.Label: Pick Priority
properties.Help: Priority Greater than Zero Receives Priority on Back Order Fill
properties.Description: The pick priority number. This field defaults from the customer and is not overrideable. It is used during back order fill ahead of the requested ship date to determine which the sequence in which order should be filled. Content:

properties.Label: Print Price
properties.Help: If yes, Prices Print on Pick Tickets
properties.Description: This flag determines if prices should be printed on the pick ticket. Content:

properties.Label: Package ID
properties.Description: The package ID associated with the order. This field will primarily be used if PM is not used. If PM is used, multiple packages can be associated to an order. This field is manually enterable during shipping.

properties.Label: Package Label
properties.Help: This message is printed on each package label
properties.Description: The package label for the last package placed on the order. Content:

properties.Label: Placed By
properties.Description: The person at the customer's site that placed the order with your company. This is an open entry field.

properties.Label: Update From Clippership
properties.Description: Used in shipping to determine if outbound freight charge (addon 2) should be updated from PM.

properties.Label: P/O Issue Dt
properties.Description: This is a hidden field in Trend used in the edi arena. The date in this field represents the issue date of the incoming edi purchase order used to create this Trend o/e order in the edepp function. The field is not updated in Trend. When the outgoing edi invoice is created for this Trend order, the oeeh.poissdt field is place in the edi 810 invoice flat file.

properties.Label: Original Addonamt
properties.Description: The previous addon amount. This is stored off when an operator adds the first package to the order. It is used to reset the outgoing freight addon (addon 2) if the operator cancels from PM.

properties.Label: Original Addon Type
properties.Description: The previous addon type. This is loaded when the operator enters the first package on this order through PM. It is used to reset the addon type when the operator cancels from PM. Content:

properties.Label: Price Level
properties.Help: Price/Discounting Setup Customer Price Level 0 - 9 (0 = Base)
properties.Description: The price code used for establishing the price level of the order (defaulted from the customer record). This value is used when pricing a line item with PDSC records. If the PDSC record is not a quantity break record, the price code will determine the level of pricing selected from the PDSC record. If the price code is changed in ARSC/S, the order will not be updated. Be sure to change the price code on the order if necessary. Content:

properties.Label: Reprint Pick Ticket
properties.Description: This flag indicates whether the pick ticket needs to be printed or not. When an order is initially added, this flag is set to yes to indicate that a pick ticket does need to be printed. Once printed, this flag is flipped to no. If a line is maintained or added, the printpckfl will again be set to yes to allow a reprint of the pick ticket.

properties.Label: PrintPrice
properties.Help: Print the Detail Prices on Invoices/Acknowledgments

properties.Label: Promised
properties.Description: The date the order was promised to the customer. The customer will request the order on the requested ship date. Due to stock out problems, drop ship lead times, etc., the promise date is set as an outside service level check. It defaults from the requested ship date but can be overridden.

properties.Label: Proposal #
properties.Description: When interfacing with CM, this is the proposal number generated in CM. It will be loaded when an order is created from CM or can be entered on a QU order.

properties.Label: Prospect #
properties.Description: When interfacing with CM, this is the prospect number attached to this order. It can be loaded when an order is generated from CM or can be entered when entering a QU order. Content:

properties.Label: P.S.T. License
properties.Description: The Provincial license number. Used for Canadian taxes.

properties.Label: PST Tax
properties.Description: The Provincial tax amount. Calculated for Canadian taxes.

properties.Label: Recovery Order
properties.Description: This field allows an order to be identified as a Recovery order. It will be automatically set to yes for orders created from the ICRS report. This field will not be available for a user to modify or to manually mark an OE order as a recovery order. A recovery order is an order created to bill the customer for inventory that has not moved within a specified period of time. This is part of the Storeroom functionality.

properties.Label: Ref
properties.Help: User Defined or Reference # (Start With . or #)
properties.Description: The order reference. This is a manually entered field. It is carried to the reference on the invoice in ARET. Content:

properties.Label: Req Ship
properties.Description: The requested ship date of the order. This is the date the customer would like you to ship the product. Service level analysis can be obtained relative to meeting this date. It defaults to today's date plus the OEAO additional days plus the ICSD cutoff.

properties.Label: Restrict Changes
properties.Description: This field is used when an order is generated from BP. It describes the restrictions on line maintenance from OE. Content:

properties.Label: Route/Day/Stop
properties.Description: The route/day/stop of the order. This is used to sort the pick tickets in a order appropriate for delivery. It defaults from the customer record. Content:

properties.Label: Row Pointer
properties.Description: A unique identifier that can be used to link other records to this particular record. Content:

properties.Label: Sales Whse
properties.Description: When Central Distribution and Regional Distribution Centers exist then users in their designated warehouses may initiate sales in other warehouses. This second warehouse field on the sales order can be used to acknowledge the warehouses or branches that are responsible for creating a sale in a shipping warehouse that is not their own. Content:

properties.Label: Set #
properties.Description: The set number relative to the journal posting for tendering. This number is incremented for each order tendered on the journal. Content:

properties.Label: Set # 2
properties.Description: The set number relative to the invoice processing journal (jrnlno2). This field is updated from OEEPI. Since OEEPI summarizes in G/L per order (a 5.1 enhancement), the setno2 will be incremented with each order invoiced.

properties.Label: Settlement Discount
properties.Description: Used in VAT Taxing only. It is the Pre-Tax settlement discount. Meaning, the actual tax amount are discounted prior to taxing - like a line discoount. The setting to use the settlement or not is controlled via tax settup screens. Content:

properties.Label: Shipped
properties.Description: The date the order was shipped. It will be automatically updated from the OEES F8 shipping, PM, or (if blank) when the order is invoiced. It can be manually entered from the shipping feedback screen.

properties.Label: Instructions
properties.Description: The shipping instructions, defaulted from the customer record.

properties.Label: Shipping Point
properties.Description: The shipping point for the order. Each order is attached to a single shipping location. The shipping point is used in PM for freight calculation and manifest printing. Content:

properties.Label: Ship Time
properties.Description: The time the order was shipped. This will be automatically loaded from OEES F8 shipping, PM, or (if the ship date is blank) from OEEPI. Content:

properties.Label: Ship To
properties.Description: The ship to location or job for the customer. This can be required entry or defaulted into OEET. If a ship to exists, pricing can be done by ship to. Also, the ship to address (rather than the customer address) will appear on all outgoing documents. The ship to can not be change after the operator presses <GO> from the banner. Content:

properties.Label: Ship
properties.Description: The shipping address for the order. This defaults from ARSC or ARSS. It can be overridden with the proper security.

properties.Label: City
properties.Description: The city the order should be shipped to. This will default from the customer or ship to address but can be overridden with the proper security.

properties.Label: Ship To:
properties.Description: The name of the customer/ship to the order will be sent to. This will appear as part of the address. Although it defaults from the customer/ship to record, it can be overridden with the proper security.
The state the order will be shipped to. This defaults from the ARSC/S record, but can be overridden with the proper security.
The zip code the order will be shipped to. This defaults from the customer/ship to record but can be overridden with the proper security.

properties.Label: Ship
properties.Description: This field describes the ship via. It is table driving in SASTT. It describes how the customer would like the goods sent to them (IE: via UPS, house delivery, ...) Content:

properties.Label: Inside Salesrep
properties.Description: The inside sales rep on the order. This default from the customer record. On a counter sale order, this is loaded to the entry operator initials. This field default to the line level and can be overridden at the line level. Content:

properties.Label: Outside Salesrep
properties.Description: The outside sales rep for the order. This field defaults from the customer record. It is used to default to the line level and is overrideable at the line level. Content:

properties.Label: Source
properties.Description: A user defined field that indicates the source of the order. It is used for Sales Analysis purposes.

properties.Label: Other Discount
properties.Description: The special discount amount calculated for the order. It is calculated based on groups of lines for each price type as defined in PDSS. It is calculated upon totalling the order. Custom special discount calculation can be available from the Software Integration group. The special discount is prorated to each associated line item during OEEPI.

label: Storeroom Auto Created Bill on Receipt Flag

properties.Label: Storeroom Auto Created Bill on Receipt Flag
Staging Area
properties.Description: The staging area for the order. This is particularly important on ship complete, will call, and tag and hold orders. If it is not entered on these orders, all "*" will print in the staging area on the pick ticket. Content:

properties.Label: Stg
properties.Description: The stage of the order. Content:

properties.Label: Taxing State
properties.Description: The state used for taxing purposes. Taxes are calculated at the end of the order (p-oetot.i). The state rates are defined in SASGS. (Canadian provinces are also set up in SASGS and validated there.) Content:

properties.Label: Standing Order Days
properties.Help: # Days From Invoice Processing Until Next Order Date
properties.Description: The number of days between generation of an order from the standing order. When a standing order is converted, a new SO or DO order is created. The requested ship date on the ST order is then updated to the requested ship date plus the standing order days (so another order will be generated that many days in the future).

properties.Label: Standing Order Type
properties.Description: The type of order the standing order should generate when it is converted. Content:

properties.Label: Subs
properties.Description: Indicates if the customer will accept product substitutes. This flag defaults from the customer/ship to record. If the customer will accept subs, substitute product will display when quantities are low of the customer requested product. Also, back order fill will fill a line with a substitute product if the original product does not come in first. Content:

properties.Label: Taken By
properties.Description: The operator that enters the order. This defaults to the log on operator initials. Content:

properties.Label: Taxable
properties.Description: This flag indicates if the customer (order) should be taxed. It defaults from the customer record but can be overridden. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Amt
properties.Description: The amount charged for state, county, city, and other taxes. This is calculated when closing an order (p-oetot.i) based on the SASGS/SASGL tables setups. Content:

properties.Label: Locality
properties.Description: The taxing authority (represents the county, city, and other taxes) associated with the order. This is defaulted from the customer/ship to record. It is used to calculate the county, city, and other taxes at the end of the order (p-oetot.i) based on the SASGL tax setup. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Default
properties.Description: Describes where the tax state and authority were defaulted from. In the general sense, if a customer physically buys product from the warehouse location, the order is taxed based on the warehouse location. If the product is shipped to the customer location, the order is taxed based on the customer location. Counter sales, will calls, and tag and hold orders determine that the taxing should be from the warehouse location. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Override
properties.Description: Indicates the taxes have been overridden. Taxes can not be manually overridden during Order Entry. If an order is generated from Batch OE, the tax override flag can be set to prevent the recalculation of taxes. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Sale Amount
properties.Description: The array contains 5 tax sale amounts. Each occurrance represents the taxable amount of the sale (rolled from taxable products on the line items) for each tax group. (Taxable addons are accumulated in the first tax sale amount.) The tax groups are defined in SASC and the tax group is identified per product in ICSWT. If the customer is not taxable, the tax sale amounts are all 0. If the customer is taxable, the tax sale amount is accumulated based on the taxability of the product. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Sale Amt 2
properties.Description: Carries the same definition as the taxsaleamt, but it is accumulated from an opposite quantity. For instance, if the taxsaleamt is accumulated from netamt, taxsaleamt2 is accumulated from netord. This field is used to properly display tendering totals based on shipped and ordered quantities. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Type
properties.Description: The Australian tax type.

properties.Label: Total Paid Amount
properties.Help: Total Amount Paid For the Current Order
properties.Description: The amount tendered on the order. This field accumulates each time a payment is taken on the order in OEET.

properties.Label: Terms Discount
properties.Description: The terms discount that can be taken in ARECE by the customer if they pay by the discount date. It is calculated each time the order is maintained (in p-oetot.i). It is identified on the ARET record when the record is created from OEEPI. Content:

properties.Label: Terms Disc - Line
properties.Description: If the terms are line based, the accumulated value of the terms as applied to each line item. Content:

properties.Label: Terms on Line Item
properties.Description: Indicates if the terms are line or header based. Content:

properties.Label: Terms Disc Pct
properties.Description: The terms percent from the SASTA record.

properties.Label: Terms
properties.Description: The terms defined for this order - defaulted from either the customer or ship to record. This can be overridden only if the operator has terms override security in SASOO.

properties.Label: Inside Commission
properties.Description: The total inside salesrep commission accumulated from the line items. The commission is not calculated until SMRC is run (after the order is invoiced). **** This field is no longer being used. The line item value of oeel.commamtin is used because sales reps may be assigned by line item. ****

properties.Label: Outside Commission
properties.Description: Accumulated from the outside salesrep commission on each line item. The commission is not calculated until SMRC is run (after the order is invoiced). **** This field is no longer being used. The line item value of oeel.commamtout is used because sales reps may be assigned by line item. ****

properties.Label: Core Charge
properties.Description: The total core charge amount as acccumulated from the line items.

properties.Label: Total Core Chrg 2
properties.Description: The total core charge as accumulated from the line items. This field is used for tendering. If totcorechg is based on oeel.qtyship, then totcorechg2 is based on oeel.qtyord and vice versa.

properties.Label: Total Cost
properties.Description: The total cost of the order as accumulated from the line items.

properties.Label: Tot Cost Ord
properties.Description: The total cost of the order accumulated from the ordered quantity on each line item.

properties.Label: Cube
properties.Description: The total cube on the order, summed from all the line items. Content:

properties.Label: Total DATC Cost
properties.Description: The total DATC cost on the order, accumulated from the line items.

properties.Label: Total DATC 2
properties.Description: Same as totdatccost but based on the opposite quantity (IE: if totdatccost is based on oeel.stkqtyship then totdatccost2 is based on stkqtyord). This field is used for tendering in order to tender from either ordered or shipped quantities.

properties.Label: Order
properties.Description: The total invoice amount of the order. The ARET invoice will be created for this amount less the tendered amount. It includes addon charges and sales taxes.

properties.Label: Ordered Inv Total
properties.Help: Invoice Value of Order Using Ordered Quantites

properties.Label: Line Items
properties.Description: This is the total net amount of all line items based on the qty shipped.

properties.Label: Order Qty Total
properties.Description: An accumulation of the total net ordered amount from the line items based on qty ordered. This number also includes sales tax and addon charges. Content:

properties.Label: Total Return for CS
properties.Description: Accumulate the net amount of all returned lines on the order. Content:

properties.Label: Order Amount
properties.Description: An interim value between the totlineamt and the totinvamt.

properties.Label: Total Price
properties.Description: The total price on the order accumulated from the line items.

properties.Label: Qty Ordered
properties.Description: The order ordered stocking quantity for all lines on the order. Content:

properties.Label: Total Qty Returned
properties.Description: The total stocking quantity returned on the order. Content:

properties.Label: Qty Shipped
properties.Description: The total stocking quantity that can be/has been shipped on the order. Content:

properties.Label: Partial Shp
properties.Description: The total stocking quantity on a non-JIT order that has been picked or on a JIT order that has been picked based on the JIT promise date.

properties.Label: Restock Charge
properties.Description: The total restocking charge on the order. This is accumulated from the line items each time a restocking charge is applied to a return line (via the F17 key). Content:

properties.Label: Total Tender Amount
properties.Description: The total amount tendered on the order. Each time a payment is taken on the order, a GLET record is created to record the details of the payment (the media type, authorization number, etc.). The tottendamt is also updated at the same time. This amount reflects the total amount tendered on all suffixes of this order. Content:

properties.Label: Weight
properties.Description: The total weight of all the lines on the order. Content:

properties.Label: Last Change Date
properties.Description: Records the date when a given record was last changed. Last changed is defined by an operator pressing GO from a setup screen, or the completion of a batch processing transaction.

properties.Label: Transfer Location

properties.Label: Total Write-Off Amt
properties.Description: The write off amount on a tendered order. This amount is an internal field and is not loaded until a tendered order is invoiced. When a tendered order is back ordered, there is room for addon/tax calculation rounding issues between the original addon/tax calculations on the -00 order and the calculations on the back order. As a result, the order can be over or under tendered by pennies. In OEAO, a downpayment write-off amount can be entered. If this amount is greater than 0, an order will be considered fully tendered if it has been tendered within range of the downpayment write-off amount. An ARET write-off transaction will be generated from OEEPI if this occurs.

properties.Label: Authorization
properties.Description: The warehouse transfer authorization. This field is enterable on the OE header but is not used anywhere.

properties.Label: Zone
properties.Description: The zone shipped to. This is loaded as the first package is entered in PMEP. It prevents us from having to look up the zone for each package - we can just look at the first package to determine the proper zone. Content:

properties.Label: Addon Amt
properties.Description: This arrayed field has 4 occurances: 1 - freight in (or addon 1) 2 - freight out (or addon 2) 3 - addon 3 4 - addon 4 The addons default onto the order from the ARSCO addon defaults (the addons are setup and described in SASTO). They are overrideable. The second addon, freight, will be updated from PM if not overridden in OE. The addon amount reflects the dollar or percentage addon (based on the addon type of a $ or %). It does not take into account the minimum or zero addon value. The calculated addon, considering these factors, is stored in addonnet.

properties.Label: Addons
properties.Description: The addon number is required for each addon amount entered. The addon number correlates to the addon defined in SASTO. It is defaulted from the customer record when the order is entered, but can be overridden. Content:

properties.Label: Addon Type
properties.Description: This field describes how the addon is calculated - as a percentage or dollar value. Content:

properties.Description: Indicates if the addon has been overridden. If the addon is manually typed in on the addon screen, this flag will be set to yes. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Group
properties.Description: This is the tax group identified with the addon. Each addon can be taxed or not taxed, and can be taxed relative to specific tax percentages defined in SASGS and SASGL by tax group. The tax group determines which tax percentages apply to this particular addon. Content:

properties.Label: Appr
properties.Help: (Y)es, (N)o or Any Other Character for Hold
properties.Description: The approval type of the order. It defaults from the OEAO screen (there is a separate default for returns). An order can not be picked until the approval type is set to "y". Content:

properties.Label: Cancel
properties.Description: The cancel date can be manually entered by an operator. If entered, it indicates that this order must be picked prior to the cancel date or the order will be cancelled. OEEPC or OEEPI will actually cancel the order. NOTE: the cancel date IS NOT set when an order is manually cancelled. Content:

properties.Label: COD
properties.Description: Indicates if an order is a COD order. An order can not be a partial COD order - it is an all or none situation. Content:

properties.Label: Company #
properties.Description: Identifies the Company under which the record was created.

properties.Label: Credit Override
properties.Description: Indicates that the terms or COD status on the order was manually overridden. Content:

properties.Label: Credit Memo Reason
properties.Description: The reason a CR or RM is done. Content:

properties.Label: Customer #
properties.Description: The customer who placed the order. Content:

properties.Label: PO
properties.Description: The customer's PO number. This can be established as a unique or non-unique number as defined in OEAO.

properties.Label: DATC
properties.Description: Indicates that the DATC cost (the label can be user defined on the OEAO screen) has been manually overridden on the addon screen. Once the DATC cost is manually overridden, it will no longer be maintained from line entry or maintenance. Content:

properties.Label: Dex Flag
properties.Description: Indicates that the order will come in to OE from Batch OE as an invoiced order. This flag was added so that the order would not be retotaled using current taxing rates or WO discounts, etc. The order will typically be transmitted from a remote site (and has already been invoiced in that remote site). Therefore, the value of the order can not be changed.

properties.Label: Division #
properties.Description: The division for the order. It is used for division GL postings when the order is invoiced. Content:

properties.Label: Downpayment
properties.Description: The actual down payment amount associated with this release/suffix. If a non-CS order is tendered, the down payment amount will reflect the amount that has been tendered. If an order is over tendered (based on the shipped amount), the operator will have the option to move part of the down payment amount to the back order. An order will not be invoiced if the down payment amount is greater than the order value. NOTE: The down payment amount and payment amounts must be in synch.

properties.Label: Down Payment Type
properties.Description: Indicates the type of down payment - in $ or a %. The down payment is always stored as a dollar amount, but can be entered as a percentage. Content:

properties.Label: Entered
properties.Description: The date the order was entered. Content:

properties.Label: Enter Time
properties.Description: The time the order was entered. Content:

properties.Label: Expiration Date
properties.Description: Expiration Date for the Credit Card

properties.Label: Geo Code
properties.Description: Taxware uses the geo code to determine which taxes should be applied if there is more than one taxing jurisdiction within a zip code. Examples of this are when a zip code crosses county lines and each county has a different tax rate or when multiple cities exist in the same zip code and each city has a different tax rate. Each taxing jurisdiction within the zip code is given a unique, two-digit identifier. Taxware uses the city name, state, zip code and geo code to find the correct tax rates. Content:

properties.Label: GST Taxable Amount
properties.Description: The GST taxable amount. This is used for Canadian taxes only.

properties.Label: G.S.T. Type
properties.Description: This represents the GST taxable type of the order. This is used for Canadian taxes only. Content:

properties.Label: Hold Order
properties.Description: This field is used to prevent a batch/order from been updated into Order Entry. It is not available from the screen and only accessible today via a Software Integration load. Content:

properties.Label: Freight In
properties.Description: The in bound freight flag is loaded from the customer record. It indicates whether we require in bound freight to be passed on to the customer. In bound freight is positionally located in the first addon field. If the in bound freight flag is yes and the first addon amount is 0, the order will not be invoiced. Content:

properties.Label: In Process
properties.Description: This field is an internal field used to indicate that the order is currently being updated through OEEBU. Content:

properties.Label: Invoice#
properties.Description: On an RM or CR, the invoice to return against. If an invoice number is entered, it must be an active invoice in ARET. When this order is invoiced, a credit is created against the entered invoice number. NOTE: This is NOT the invoice number of this order. The order number always equates to the invoice number of this particular order. Content:
For a CR or RM, the invoice suffix this order should be applied against. When this order is invoiced, a credit is created against the invno/invsuf in ARET. Content:

properties.Label: Job #
properties.Description: The job number as it relates to the ship to entered on the order. This field provides a default to the line level job number. Content:

properties.Label: Language Code
properties.Description: The language code that describes the language for the customer. Content:

properties.Label: Notes
properties.Description: Indicates if the order has required or non-required notes. Required notes will be displayed in any entry function. Content:

properties.Label: Last Change By
properties.Description: Tags the record with the login initials of the last operator to update the record. Last update is defined by the operator pressing GO on a setup screen, or by the completion of a transaction in a batch updating process.

properties.Label: Disposition
properties.Description: The disposition of the order. Content:

properties.Label: Order #
properties.Description: The order number of the order. If the order number is entered, it will be used to create an order with this number through OEEBU. Content:

properties.Label: Order Origin Code
properties.Description: The origin code indicates where the OE order was created. The code may be entered by the user or it may be loaded on the order automatically. The areas where the code will be automatically are: SX.api PCM Configurator Consolidated Invoice Tool Crib Counter Sale EDI Import Excel Import Job Management Receive On Account eStorefront Storerooom Service Warranty Other Content:

properties.Label: Freight Out
properties.Description: The out bound freight flag indicates that out bound freight on this order is required. It initially defaults from the customer record. If this flag is set to yes, addon 2 is required prior to invoicing the order. Content:

properties.Label: Pay Amount
properties.Description: The payment made on the order. NOTE: This field is not longer used.

properties.Label: Placed By
properties.Description: The person at the customer's site that placed the order with your company. This is an open entry field.

properties.Label: PreAuthorization #
properties.Description: Preauthorization # that was provided from the 3rd Party Credit Card company

properties.Label: Price Level
properties.Help: Price/Discounting Setup Customer Price Level 0 - 9 (0 = Base)
properties.Description: The price code used for establishing the price level of the order (defaulted from the customer record). This value is used when pricing a line item with PDSC records. If the PDSC record is not a quantity break record, the price code will determine the level of pricing selected from the PDSC record. If the price code is changed in ARSC/S, the order will not be updated. Be sure to change the price code on the order if necessary. Content:

properties.Label: Promised
properties.Description: The date the order was promised to the customer. The customer will request the order on the requested ship date. Due to stock out problems, drop ship lead times, etc., the promise date is set as an outside service level check. It defaults from the requested ship date but can be overridden.

properties.Label: P.S.T. License
properties.Description: The Provincial license number. Used for Canadian taxes.

properties.Label: Ref
properties.Help: User Defined or Reference # (Start With . or #)
properties.Description: The order reference. This is a manually entered field. It is carried to the reference on the invoice in ARET. Content:

properties.Label: Req Ship
properties.Description: The requested ship date of the order. This is the date the customer would like you to ship the product. Service level analysis can be obtained relative to meeting this date. It defaults to today's date plus the OEAO additional days plus the ICSD cutoff.

properties.Label: Restrict Changes
properties.Description: This field is used when an order is generated from BP. It describes the restrictions on line maintenance in OE. Content:

properties.Label: Route/Day/Stop
properties.Description: The route/day/stop of the order. This is used to sort the pick tickets in a order appropriate for delivery. It defaults from the customer record. Content:

properties.Label: Seq #
properties.Description: The sequence number defines the sequence of this order within the batch name. It is part of the primary key along with the company and batch name. It is used to uniquely identify an order within a batch.

properties.Label: Shipped
properties.Description: The date the order was shipped. It will be automatically updated from the OEES F8 shipping, PM, or (if blank) when the order is invoiced. It can be manually entered from the shipping feedback screen. It is used in batch to load the ship date of a previously shipped order.

properties.Label: Instructions
properties.Description: The shipping instructions, defaulted from the customer record.

properties.Label: Ship Time
properties.Description: The time the order was shipped. This will be automatically loaded from OEES F8 shipping, PM, or (if the ship date is blank) from OEEPI. It is used in batch to load the ship time of a previously shipped order. Content:

properties.Label: Ship To
properties.Description: The ship to location or job for the customer. This can be required entry or defaulted into OEET. If a ship to exists, pricing can be done by ship to. Also, the ship to address (rather than the customer address) will appear on all outgoing documents. The ship to can not be change after the operator presses <GO> from the banner. Content:

properties.Label: Ship
properties.Description: The shipping address for the order. This defaults from ARSC or ARSS. It can be overridden with the proper security.

properties.Label: City
properties.Description: The city the order should be shipped to. This will default from the customer or ship to address but can be overridden with the proper security.

properties.Label: Ship To:
properties.Description: The name of the customer/ship to the order will be sent to. This will appear as part of the address. Although it defaults from the customer/ship to record, it can be overridden with the proper security.
The state the order will be shipped to. This defaults from the ARSC/S record, but can be overridden with the proper security.
The zip code the order will be shipped to. This defaults from the customer/ship to record but can be overridden with the proper security.

properties.Label: Ship
properties.Description: This field describes the ship via. It is table driving in SASTT. It describes how the customer would like the goods sent to them (IE: via UPS, house delivery, ...) Content:

properties.Label: Inside Salesrep
properties.Description: The inside sales rep on the order. This default from the customer record. On a counter sale order, this is loaded to the entry operator initials. This field default to the line level and can be overridden at the line level. Content:

properties.Label: Outside Salesrep
properties.Description: The outside sales rep for the order. This field defaults from the customer record. It is used to default to the line level and is overrideable at the line level. Content:

properties.Label: Other Discount
properties.Description: The special discount amount calculated for the order. It is calculated based on groups of lines for each price type as defined in PDSS. It is calculated upon totalling the order. Custom special discount calculation can be available from the Software Integration group. The special discount is prorated to each associated line item during OEEPI. For batch, this field is used for an order that has already been invoiced. To maintain it's value, set the oeehb.dexfl = yes. Content:

properties.Label: Stg
properties.Description: The stage of the order. Content:

properties.Label: Taxing State
properties.Description: The state used for taxing purposes. Taxes are calculated at the end of the order (p-oetot.i). The state rates are defined in SASGS. To maintain the taxes on the order through OEEBU, set the oeehb.dexfl = yes. (Canadian provinces are also set up in SASGS and validated there.) Content:

properties.Label: Subs
properties.Description: Indicates if the customer will accept product substitutes. This flag defaults from the customer/ship to record. If the customer will accept subs, substitute product will display when quantities are low of the customer requested product. Also, back order fill will fill a line with a substitute product if the original product does not come in first. Content:

properties.Label: Taken By
properties.Description: The operator that enters the order. This defaults to the log on operator initials. Content:

properties.Label: Taxable
properties.Description: This flag indicates if the customer (order) should be taxed. It defaults from the customer record but can be overridden. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Amt
properties.Description: The amount charged for state, county, city, and other taxes. This is calculated when closing an order (p-oetot.i) based on the SASGS/SASGL tables setups. To maintain the current taxes through OEEBU, set the oeehb.dexfl = yes. Content:

properties.Label: Locality
properties.Description: The taxing authority (represents the county, city, and other taxes) associated with the order. This is defaulted from the customer/ship to record. It is used to calculate the county, city, and other taxes at the end of the order (p-oetot.i) based on the SASGL tax setup. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Default
properties.Description: Describes where the tax state and authority were defaulted from. In the general sense, if a customer physically buys product from the warehouse location, the order is taxed based on the warehouse location. If the product is shipped to the customer location, the order is taxed based on the customer location. Counter sales, will calls, and tag and hold orders determine that the taxing should be from the warehouse location. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Override
properties.Description: Indicates the taxes have been overridden. Taxes can not be manually overridden during Order Entry. If an order is generated from Batch OE, the tax override flag can be set to prevent the recalculation of taxes. Content:

properties.Label: Tax Sale Amount
properties.Description: The array contains 5 tax sale amounts. Each occurrance represents the taxable amount of the sale (rolled from taxable products on the line items) for each tax group. (Taxable addons are accumulated in the first tax sale amount.) The tax groups are defined in SASC and the tax group is identified per product in ICSWT. If the customer is not taxable, the tax sale amounts are all 0. If the customer is taxable, the tax sale amount is accumulated based on the taxability of the product. To maintain the current tax sale amount through OEEBU, set the oeehb.dexfl = yes. Content:

properties.Label: Terms
properties.Description: The terms defined for this order - defaulted from either the customer or ship to record. This can be overridden only if the operator has terms override security in SASOO. Content:

properties.Label: Core Charge
properties.Description: The total core charge amount as acccumulated from the line items. Content:

properties.Label: Total DATC Cost
properties.Description: The total DATC cost on the order, accumulated from the line items. Content:

properties.Label: Order
properties.Description: The total invoice amount of the order. The ARET invoice will be created for this amount less the tendered amount. To maintain the value of the total invoice amount through OEEBU, set the oeehb.dexfl = yes. Content:

properties.Label: Line Items
properties.Description: This is the total net amount of all line items. Content:

properties.Label: Total Return for CS
properties.Description: Accumulate the net amount of all returned lines on the order. Content:

properties.Label: Restock Charge
properties.Description: The total restocking charge on the order. This is accumulated from the line items each time a restocking charge is applied to a return line (via the F17 key). Content:

properties.Label: Last Change Date
properties.Description: Records the date when a given record was last changed. Last changed is defined by an operator pressing GO from a setup screen, or the completion of a batch processing transaction.

properties.Label: Trans Proc
properties.Description: The function to last update this record

properties.Label: Last Change Time
properties.Description: This is the time portion of the last date/time a given record was changed. Record changed is defined by either an operator pressing GO from a setup screen, or the completion of a processing transaction (ie. Invoiced OE line) in batch type functions.

properties.Label: Type
properties.Help: SO, QU, FO, CR, or RM
properties.Description: The transaction type of the order. This describes the kind of order it is. Supported through batch are: SO - stock order (reserves inventory. Entry into stage 1) QU - quote (does not reserve inventory. Entry into stage 0. Converted/ copied through the F7 copy) FO - future order (does not reserve inventory. Entry into stage 0. Converted to a SO through OEEPC or OEEPI when the promise date - oeeh.longltdays - sasc.oefutdays - sasc.oereqdays <= today) Content:

properties.Label: Use STEP
properties.Help: Should Taxware Use STEP Data to Calculate Taxes On This Order

properties.Label: Default Whse
properties.Description: The warehouse on the order. An order can be entered for only a single warehouse. (If inventory is to be relieved in a different warehouse, the alternate warehouse can be used.) The warehouse on the order is the warehouse the order is picked from the the warehouse that gets credit for the sale. Content:

properties.Label: Order Discount
properties.Description: The whole order discount amount. This amount is loaded based on the PDSW setup.

properties.Label: WO Disc Override
properties.Description: Indicates if the whole order discount has been manually overridden. If it has been manually entered, it will no longer be calculated from PDSW during order totaling. Content:

properties.Label: WO Disc%
properties.Description: The whole order discount percent if the whole order discount is based on a percentage. This field is generated from PDSW during order totalling.

properties.Label: Order Disc Type
properties.Description: The whole order discount type. This field defines whether the wodiscamt or wodiscpct is used as the whole order discount. Content:

properties.Label: Batch
properties.Description: This is the name of the batch order. It is the key to this file along with other fields. The OEEHBR is structured to be a generic file to define Blanket Release (BR) orders. It will initially be used during the bid prep release process, but may be used in the future to define Blanket Release information in the OEET or OEEBT functions. Content:

properties.Label: Bill
properties.Description: The effective billing date of the invoice. When the order is invoiced, the bill date will become the due date of the invoice. Content:

properties.Label: Company #
properties.Description: Identifies the Company under which the record was created.

properties.Label: Customer #
properties.Description: The customer who places the order. Content:

properties.Label: Lump Bill Amount
properties.Description: The lump bill amount is enterable on either a BL or BR to provide the billing amount to the customer. If each suffix should be billed a fixed rate regardless of the delivery of products on each release, the lump bill amount should be used. The invoice in ARET will be created for the lump bill amount when the order is invoiced.

properties.Label: Lump Sum Bill
properties.Description: Indicates if the lump billing amount should be used when invoicing the customer. The flag allows the flexibility to invoice the customer a 0 amount on a particular invoice. Content:

properties.Label: Print Lump Prices
properties.Description: Indicates that lump bill prices should be printed on the invoice. Content:

properties.Label: Last Change By
properties.Description: Tags the record with the login initials of the last operator to update the record. Last update is defined by the operator pressing GO on a setup screen, or by the completion of a transaction in a batch updating process.

properties.Label: Order #
properties.Description: The order number of the Blanket Release order. This is part of the primary key and has been defined in this file to be used in the future if the Blanket Release orders are to be created in OEET using this file structure. In the case of bid prep release, the orderno will be zero. Content:

properties.Label: Order Suffix
properties.Description: The order suffix of the Blanket Release order. This will be assigned by the Blanket Release screen whan a new Blanket Release order is created. Content:

properties.Label: Promised
properties.Description: The date the order was promised to the customer. The customer will request the order on the requested ship date. Due to stock out problems, drop ship lead times, etc.., the promise date is set as an outside service level check. It defaults from the requested ship date but can be overridden.

properties.Label: Req Ship
properties.Description: The requested ship date of the order. This is the date the customer would like you to ship the product. Service level analysis can be obtained relative to meeting this date. It defaults to the promised date in each Blanket Release order.

properties.Label: Seq #
properties.Description: The seqno defines the sequence number within the batch. In the case of bid prep release, when the OEEHBR/OEELBR records are created to define a blanket release, a seqno of 1 will be used. This field is part of the primary key so a future enhancement may use this file structure to provide Blanket Releases created in OEET and OEEBT.

properties.Label: Instructions
properties.Description: Shipping instructions, defaulted from the customer/ship to record.

properties.Label: Ship To
properties.Description: The ship to location or job for the customer for this Blanket Release order.

properties.Label: Ship
properties.Description: The shipping address for the order. This defaults from ARSC or ARSS. It can be overridden with the proper security.

properties.Label: City
properties.Description: The city the order should be shipped to. This will default from the customer or ship to address but can be overridden with the proper security.

properties.Label: Ship To:
properties.Description: The name of the customer/ship to the order will be sent to. This will appear as part of the address. Although it defaults from the customer/ship to record, it can be overridden with the proper security.
The state the order will be shipped to. This defaults from the ARSC/ARSS record, but can be overridden with the proper security.
The zip code the order will be shipped to. This defaults from the customer/ship to record but can be overridden with proper security.

properties.Label: Ship
properties.Description: This field describes the ship via. It is table driven in SASTT. It describes how the customer would like the goods sent to them (IE: via UPS, house delivery, ..). Content:

properties.Label: Discount %
properties.Description: The discount percent that qualified for the price type group. This is loaded based on the PDSS quantity break the line items qualify for. It is based on the accumulated order quantity or net for the lines on the -00 order. When a back order is created, the discount percent from the -00 OEEHS will be copied to the back order.

properties.Label: Discount Type
properties.Description: ** This field is not used in standard Trend. It has been used in the past for custom modifications. ** Content:

properties.Label: Net Amt
properties.Description: The net amount represents the accumulated net amount of the lines in this price type. It is used with the discount percent to calculate the special discount amount for this price type. Content:

properties.Label: Next level
properties.Description: ** This field is not used in standard Trend. It has been used in the past for custom modifications. **

properties.Label: Next Discount %
properties.Description: ** This field is not used in standard Trend. It has been used in the past for custom modifications. **

properties.Label: # of Lines
properties.Description: The number of lines items the match the price type for the found PDSS record. This number is used in OEEPI for proration of the special discount. Each line will get a percentage of the calculated discount until the last line - it will get the remainder. Content:

properties.Label: Last Change By
properties.Description: Tags the record with the login initials of the last operator to update the record. Last update is defined by the operator pressing GO on a setup screen, or by the completion of a transaction in a batch updating process.

properties.Label: Order #
properties.Description: The order number of the order. This is the primary key. Content:

properties.Label: Order Suffix
properties.Description: The order suffix of the order. The -00 always indicates the original order. Any other order can be a back order or a release, depending on the order type. Only a BR and jit order can have releases with suffixes greater that -00. The borelfl indicates if the suffix is a back order or not. Back orders are created through oeetbo.p Content:

properties.Label: Orig Disc
properties.Description: The original discount amount represents the special discount amount for the price type grouping. It is stored as well as the special discount amount in OEEHS and used during the proration process in OEEPI. When prorating to each line, the % of the total net amount the line represents in the price type group is applied against the original discount amount. The special discount amount is then lowered by the amount prorated to each line. The remaining specdiscamt is loaded onto the last line item for the price type. Content:

properties.Label: Price Type
properties.Description: The price type defines a group of products that are similarly priced. This field is used for PDSC level 2, 5, and 8 pricing. It is also used to group products for PDSS pricing. Content:

properties.Label: Other Discount
properties.Description: The special discount amount calculated for the price type grouping. It is calculated based on groups of lines for each price type as defined in PDSS. It is calculated upon totalling the order. Custom special discount calculation can be available from the Software Integration group. The special discount is prorated to each associated line item during OEEPI. Content:

properties.Label: Last Change Date
properties.Description: Records the date when a given record was last changed. Last changed is defined by an operator pressing GO from a setup screen, or the completion of a batch processing transaction.

properties.Label: Trans Proc
properties.Description: The function to last update this record

properties.Label: Last Change Time
properties.Description: This is the time portion of the last date/time a given record was changed. Record changed is defined by either an operator pressing GO from a setup screen, or the completion of a processing transaction (ie. Invoiced OE line) in batch type functions.
