properties.Description: A unique identifier that links this record to another particular record via that records rowpointer stored in this source field. Content:

properties.Label: Alternate Product Group
properties.Description: Added with JIRA SXWEB-13468. Populated only on Non-Stocks. Contains the Alternate product Group Content:

properties.Label: Alt Whse
properties.Description: The alternate warehouse if an alternate warehouse is selected. If the OEAO alternate warehouse flag is set to yes, the operator may select an alternate warehouse when it is displayed with substitutes and upgrades when the ordering warehouse is short stock. Selection of the secondary warehouse allows stock to be reserved in the alternate warehouse and transferred (a WT is generated in OEEPI) to the selling warehouse. All pricing/costing is per the selling warehouse. The alternate warehouse just provides the capability to do an automatic transfer.

properties.Label: ARP Line
properties.Description: The product line or warehouse this product is sourced from. This field is only loaded for non-stock products, special order items, and drop ship lines. For a non-stock product, this field is enterable on the non-stock screen. If the ARP whse on the non-stock screen is entered, the arpprodline will contain the whse and the arpvendno will be 0. If the ARP whse is not entered on the non-stock screen, the arpprodline will contain the product line entered on the non-stock screen. For a stocked product, this field defaults from either the ARP whse (if the ARP is a whse) or the ARP product line set in ICSW. This field is used for special and non-stock lines that need to be picked up on a RRAR. Content:

properties.Label: ARP Vendor #
properties.Description: The ARP vendor number is used to indicate who the line is sourced from (if sourced from a vendor). It is only loaded on a non-stock product, special order line, or drop ship line. On a non-stock, it is loaded with the vendor entered on the non-stock screen. For a stocked special or DO line, it is l oaded with the ARP vendor from ICSW. If the line is a DO line or tied line, the vendor is overrideable from the F6 function key on the extended screen. If no vendor exists in ICSW, this field will contain a 0.

properties.Label: Date Paid Invoice Reversal
properties.Description: Loaded during ARECR, AR Payment Reversal, this is the date that the payment posted for this order was reversed. Content:

properties.Label: Bin Loc
properties.Description: The bin location for the product. This field is loaded during picking when pick tickets are printed in bin location order.

properties.Label: BO #
properties.Description: The number of the suffix this line was back ordered on. If the bono is 0, a back order has not been generated for the line item (it may be generated in a later stage).

properties.Label: B/O
properties.Description: The back order type for the order. This field defaults to "d" on a DO order, "y" if the customer accepts back orders, or "n" if the customer does not accept back orders.

properties.Label: Cancelled Date
properties.Description: The date the order line was cancelled. Content:

properties.Label: Cart Identifier
properties.Description: Cart Identifier for the Equate Pricing call. Each call made to Equate Pricer will have an unqiue identifier. Content:

properties.Label: Added From Catalog
properties.Description: Indicates if an order as needed product was added from the catalog when this line was added. If the product was not set up when the line was added but was defined in the catalog file, the operator has the option to create an ICSP/W record automatically. If the new records are created, this flag is set to yes. If the catalog product is pulled into the order as a non-stock product, this flag remains no. OERE reports all products added from the catalog file as lines are added.

properties.Label: Catch Wt
properties.Description: Indicates if the charge quantity needs to be entered on the line item for a catch weight product. If the quantity shipped is greater than 0 and the charge quantity = 0, this flag will be yes. Otherwise it will be no. (NOTE: we do not allow enter of catch weight products in ICSP as of V3.0. Keep all logic that references charge quantity as we may reinstitute catch weight in a new form in the future.) Content:

properties.Label: Name
properties.Description: Name of the individual that has Certification on File for this Product on the Order

properties.Label: Certified Nbr
properties.Description: Certification # of the individual that has Certification on File for this Product on the Order

properties.Label: Certified Organization
properties.Description: Certification Organization of the individual that has Certification on File for this Product on the Order

properties.Label: Configure Kit
properties.Description: Configurator Integration - Product requires configuration

properties.Label: ChgQty
properties.Help: If Yes, Quantity Ordered was Changed in the Backordered Stage

properties.Label: ChgtoLn
properties.Description: "The line number that this line was changed to - when the product or unit of measure is changed on an OEET line, a new OEEL line is created – however, this will be a cross reference to the new line that was created."

properties.Label: Charge Qty
properties.Description: The charge quantity for a catch weight product. This field is enterable on the extended screen in OEES. It is used to reprice/cost the line items based on the weight of the line. (NOTE: we now longer allow entry of a catch weight product in ICSP as of V3.0. Keep all code intact in case we reestablish this functionality.)

properties.Label: In
properties.Description: The commission calculated for the inside sales person based on the sale of this line item. This amount is calculated in SMRC based on the commission setup in SM.

properties.Label: Salesrep Commission - Out
properties.Description: The commission amount calculated for the outside sales person. This amount is calculated in SMRC based on the commission setup in SM. Content:

properties.Label: Comm Cost
properties.Description: The commission cost. This is the product cost used in the commission calculation. It is loaded on the line in OEEPI based on the ICAO settings for commission cost.

properties.Label: Comment
properties.Description: The comment flag for the line item. If a comment exists on the line (stored in COM based on the order/suffix/line), a "c" will display to the left of the line item on the Order Entry screen. Content:

properties.Label: Manual Commission
properties.Description: This flag indicates that the commission has been manually overridden in SMAL. Content:

properties.Label: Comm Paid
properties.Description: Indicates if the commission has been paid. This flag is updated from SMRC when a commission is calculated and paid. Content:

properties.Label: Comm Paid
properties.Description: Indicates if the commission has been paid for the inside sales person. This field is updated to yes from SMRC. Content:

properties.Label: Commission
properties.Description: Describes whether the commission amount is a % or a $. Content:

properties.Label: All Packages Shipped
properties.Description: If the system is set to use Cartonization, there are two places to set the system to validate if the Cartons assigned to an order line are in shipped stage before allowing the Order to Ship. ICSD - Whse (icsd.cnconfirmshipfl) ARSC - Customer (arsc.cnconfirmshipty) When all the Packages are Shipped that are assigned to a line item, and either of the settings in ARSC or ICSD are set to confirm shipments, then the field value is set to 'yes' Content:

properties.Label: Company #
properties.Description: Identifies the Company under which the record was created.

properties.Label: Contract Number
properties.Description: Special Pricing Agreement (SPA) contract number for order line.

properties.Label: Contract End Date
properties.Description: Special Pricing Agreement (SPA) contract end date for order line.

properties.Label: Contract Start Date
properties.Description: Special Pricing Agreement (SPA) contract start date for order line.

properties.Label: Core Charge
properties.Description: The core charge for the product. This charge defaults to the line item from ICSP. It is expressed in the selling unit of measure.

properties.Label: Core Charge
properties.Description: The core charge type. If the line is eligible for a core charge (ICSP core charge is > 0), the core charge will be enterable from the extended screen. A core can also be returned. This field distinguishes between the 3 situations. Content:

properties.Label: Cost Over
properties.Description: The cost override flag indicates if the cost has been manually entered. Content:

properties.Label: Country of Origin
properties.Description: Country Of Origin

properties.Label: CR Invoice #
properties.Description: CR Invoice #

properties.Label: CR Invoice Suffix
properties.Description: CR Invoice Suffix

properties.Label: Credit Memo Reason
properties.Description: The credit reason type. If this field is entered on the banner on a CR or RM order, it will default to the line item. It can be overridden on a return line when F17 is pressed to return a line. Content:

properties.Label: Cube
properties.Description: The number of cubic units for the entire line item. Content:

properties.Label: Customer Cost
properties.Description: The cost of a product that has been identified as customer owned inventory in a storeroom mananged warehouse. Since the customer already owns the inventory, the cost shown on the OE line will be zero. This field tracks the value of the customer owned inventory.

properties.Label: Customer #
properties.Description: The customer on the order. Content:

properties.Label: Cut?
properties.Help: Was Cut Allocation Done on This Line?
properties.Description: SXRF Cut Product Cut Line Flag

properties.Label: Cut Loss Amount
properties.Help: Enter the Cut Loss Amount for This Line
properties.Description: SXRF Cut Product Cut Loss Amount

properties.Label: DATC
properties.Description: The "destination area transportation charge" for this line item represented in the selling unit. The field was originally established to be a datc cost. It has since be expanded (V4.5) to be a line addon charge. The label of the cost is user defined. If it is defined in ICAO, this charge can be entered (and will default from ICSW.DATCCOST or ARSC.ARDATCCOST or SASC.ICDATCCOST depending on the value of ARSC.ARDATCTY). This field is used to pass an additional charge to the customer based on the product sold and how it is sold (IE: if the product was rushed to the customer). Field = icsw.datccost (or arsc.ardatccost or sasc.icdatccost) * (Product Conversion Factor from p-unit.i)

properties.Label: Discount
properties.Description: The discount amount of the line item. This field is represented in the selling unit of measure (if the product is a specially costed product, this field is represented in the special costing unit). The discount amount can be calculated from the PDSC setup (and is thus a % discount). It can also be manually overridden and set to a $ discount.

properties.Label: Other Disc
properties.Description: The prorated special discount amount. The oeeh.specdiscamt is prorated to the line items in OEEPI based on net amount of the line.

properties.Label: Line Disc Level
properties.Description: This field indicates the discount level if it is manually entered on the F12 screen from the discount field. If PDSC pricing is done, the discount code will remain 0. Content:

properties.Label: Disc Over
properties.Description: Indicates that the discount has been overridden. If either the price or discount is overridden, it is considered a manual price and will not be recalculated through line item pricing. Content:

properties.Label: Discount %
properties.Description: The discount percent on the line item. It can be calculated from the PDSC records or manually entered on a line item. If the discount type is a dollar, the discount percent is still calculated.

properties.Label: Discount Type
properties.Description: The discount type for the line item. It indicates if the discount is a percent or a dollar. Either way, both the discamt and discpct are calculated and stored. Content:

properties.Label: PO/WT BO Status
properties.Description: This field is the back order type for a drop ship line. It holds the "y" or "n" indicator from the customer since the botype is used to record that this is a drop ship line. Once the PO has been received, if the PO is back ordered, the dobotype will be set to "y". If the PO is not back ordered or if it is received in full, the dobotype will be set to no.

properties.Label: ECCN
properties.Description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)

properties.Label: Entered
properties.Description: The date the order was added. When a back order is created, the enter date is reset to the date the back order is created.

properties.Label: esRqstId
properties.Description: This is the eSource Request Id that is stored on the Order Entry Line to be picked up by POERR so the buyer can review the request for approval.

properties.Label: GL Cost
properties.Description: This field represents the cost as posted from GL after invoicing has occurred. In ICAO (chui) or AO-Products-Costs(GUI), the G/L cost field will determine if this field is assigned by avg cost, replacement, standard, last cost or FIFO. This cost is used in OEEJ and for GL postings.

properties.Label: G.S.T. Status
properties.Description: This field is used for Canadian taxes. Content:

properties.Label: Hard Price
properties.Help: PDSP System Price Record is a Hard Set Price
properties.Description: If the sasoo.oehardprcovrfl is set to no and the pdsp.hardpriceflag is set to yes then the oe line price/discount cannot be changed or repriced.

properties.Label: High Tolerance Price
properties.Description: This is the calculated highest price based on the tolerances in the pricing record for the line product in line units. A user without permission to override pricing tolerances cannot change the price for the product to be higher than this value. Content:

properties.Label: Highest Price Line#
properties.Description: If the price was retrieved using the Highest Price inquiry of customer orders, this is the order line the price was retrieved from.

properties.Label: Highest Price Order Number
properties.Description: If the price was retrieved using the Highest Price inquiry of customer orders, this is the order number the price was retrieved from.

properties.Label: Highest Price Order Suffix
properties.Description: If the price was retrieved using the Highest Price inquiry of customer orders, this is the order suffix the price was retrieved from.

properties.Label: Spec Rec Link
properties.Help: Special Price/Cost Record Number for Link to Transactions
properties.Description: This field will identify the special price/costing data that is related to this record. This number can be matched up to the ICSS record with the primary unique key k-icss.

properties.Label: Inventory Type
properties.Description: The inventory type will be used to indicate if the OE line was entered for customer-owned inventory or distributor-owned inventory. This field will only be loaded with a C or D if the order was placed in a storeroom mananged warehouse. OE lines for customer owned inventory must be handled differently because it is product that the customer has already purchased. Content:

properties.Label: Invoice
properties.Description: The date the order was invoiced through OEEPI. This date is set to the posting date entered during the OEEPI run.

properties.Label: JIT Picked
properties.Description: This flag indicates that a "just in time" line item has been picked. JIT orders are established by an orderdisp of "j". Only lines that should be picked based on the promise date of the line item will be picked. When these lines are picked, the jitpickfl will be set to yes. Once the line is set to yes, it qualifies for shipping and invoicing. The lines not picked will move to a new release when the lines that have been picked are invoiced. Content:

properties.Label: Refer
properties.Description: The job number on the line item. This number defaults from the job number attached to the ARSS record. If a job number exists on the PDSC record that is used for pricing, it will override the ARSS job number. This field prints on the PO and WT RRAR reports.

properties.Label: Word Index
properties.Description: Internal field used for keyword processing Content:

properties.Label: Kit
properties.Description: This field indicates that the line is a Build On Demand kit and OEELK records are attached to the line item. It will be set to yes for a Non-Stock kit or a Build On Demand kit. It is important to set correctly so that the price/cost roll will work properly and inventory will be affected for components. The kitfl would be set to no for a Prebuilt kit since OEELK records will not exist.

properties.Label: OE Kit Rollup
properties.Description: The kit roll type indicates if price or cost should be rolled from the components to the kit level. Content:

properties.Label: Lead Time
properties.Description: The lead time is enterable on all order types on the extended screen. It is used to update OEEH.longltdays - this number represents the line with the longest lead time. If is line with the longest lead time is deleted or the lead time is changed to under longltdays, the longltdays is not decremented. Content:

properties.Label: Line # Alternate
properties.Description: The line alternate number indicates the PO or WT line that this order is tied to. This field is not enterable from OE but is updated when a PO or WT line is created from the order (on a drop line or a tie).

properties.Label: Line#
properties.Description: he line number of the order entry line. This field is automatically incremented each time a line is added. It is loaded from oeeh.nextlineno (and oeeh.nextlineno on the -00 suffix is incremented each time a line is added to any suffix of the order). The line number is carried to all back orders and releases. For instance, if lines 1 and 2 are fully filled and line 3 back orders onto the -01 suffix, it will carry line "3" to the back order.

properties.Label: Lost Business Reason
properties.Description: The lost business type indicates the reason why the line was set to lost business. It is a use defined value and entered once "l" is put in the special/non-stock type. Content:

properties.Label: Low Tolerance Price
properties.Description: This is the calculated lowest price based on the tolerances in the pricing record for the line product in line units. A user without permission to override pricing tolerances cannot change the price for the product to be lower than this value.

properties.Label: Manufacturer Commission Amount
properties.Description: Total Amount of the Commission to be paid for this item by the Manufacturer. This field value is used in Invoicing to calculate the Accounts Receivable invoice amount for payment by the vendor (ARET) Calculated at the time the Manufacturer Order is created. The field can be changed by the operator within Line Entry Content:

properties.Label: Manufacturer Commission Override
properties.Description: When the orderator manually changes the calculated manufacturer commission amount on the line item.

properties.Label: Manufacturer Commission Percent
properties.Description: Percentage of the Commission to be paid for this item by the Manufacturer. Calculated at the time the Manufacturer Order is created. The field can be changed by the operator within Line Entry The Commission Rate in OESM can be a Percentage or Amount. The line item will store both. Allows for the operator to easily make a change to the commission to be paid on the line items. Was 20% now 21% Content:

properties.Label: Manufacturer Commission Rate Type
properties.Description: Used to load mancommamt and mancommpct on the line items. Allowed to be changed by the operator per line item. From amount to percent Initially loaded from the rate found in OESM for the item Content:

properties.Label: Manufacturer Commission Record #
properties.Description: Loaded from OESM (Manufacturer Commission Rates) when pulling a rate for use on the line item. Reflects the Commission Rate record (OESM) used when calculating the Commission Amount on the line item. Content:

properties.Label: Net Amt
properties.Description: The net amount of the line item. This field is used to roll up to the totlineamt on the order. It is the fully extended price and discount of the line. It is calculated by taking the price - discount and multiplying by qtyship.

properties.Label: Net Ord
properties.Description: The extended ordered amount of the line item. This field is used to roll to oeeh.totlineord. This is calculated by taking the price - discount and multiplying by the qtyord.

properties.Label: Added From Non Stock
properties.Description: Indicates that an ICSW record was created from a Catalog or Non Stock item.

properties.Label: Review Inv For NS
properties.Description: This field will indicate whether or not the nonstock product on the current OE line should be flagged for review for the possible conversion of the nonstock product to a stocked product in ICSW. This field displays on the OE Non Stock screen conditionally based on the Event Trigger to Review Inventory being 'active' in the system. If the trigger is not active, then the setting is not available off the non stock screen. Content:

properties.Label: Non Tax Reason
properties.Description: The non tax type indicates why a line is not taxable. If the order is not taxable, this field defaults from the header non tax reason. If the product is not taxable, it defaults from the ICSW non tax reason. Otherwise it is set to the header non tax reason. Content:

properties.Label: # SN/Lots
properties.Description: The number of serial/lot records that have yet to be assigned on this line item. A product is either a serially controlled, lot controlled, or uncontrolled product. If it is serial or lot controlled, the proper number of serial records or lot quantities need to be attached to the order before the order can be invoiced. This number is originally set to the oeel.stkqtyship for a line item. As serial/lot quantities are entered, the number decrements (and can not go negative - we will force the operator back to the serial/lot screen if quantities are over allocated). This field rolls up to oeeh.nosnlots. Once oeeh.nosnlots = 0, all serial/lot lines have been fully allocated and the order can be invoiced. Content:

properties.Label: # Sn/Lots-Kits
properties.Description: Same as the nosnlots except this field refers to kit components rather than to the product on the line item. It is accumulated for all kit components. It rolls with nosnlots into oeeh.nosnlots. Content:

properties.Label: # Times Chg
properties.Description: The number of times a line item has been changed. Content:

properties.Label: Last Change By
properties.Description: Tags the record with the login initials of the last operator to update the record. Last update is defined by the operator pressing GO on a setup screen, or by the completion of a transaction in a batch updating process.

properties.Label: Related Order #
properties.Description: The alternate order number indicates the PO/WT/work order number that the order entry order is tied to. This number is enterable on the extended screen of the line item. If the order is a pick up on the way, drop ship, or tie, the PO/WT number can be automatically generated when go is pressed from the line item. On a pick up on the way or tie line the PO/WT number can also be entered. Content:

properties.Label: Order #
properties.Description: The order number of the line item. This field is part of the primary key. Content:

properties.Label: Order Rep 1 Percent
properties.Description: This field stores an additional order rep percentage that can be assigned to an order. Setups in ARSC will copy to ARSS on a copy and can use the AO logic to copy to ARSS if ARSC is changed (SXE-2803). When an order is created, OEEH defaults from ARSC/ARSS and then OEEL defaults from OEEH. The operator can update the assignments in OEEH/OEEL for individual order/line specifics. Once the data is stored in the OEEH/OEEL records in the database, it will be sent to DataLake and any analysis/calculations (usually for commissions) against these fields will be done in Birst. There are five of these fields that can be used. Note that the field number must match to the ordrep field number, i.e., if ordrep2 is assigned a value and you want a percentage related to that, the percentage must be specified in orderreppct2, the 2 must match on both fields to correlate them. Added with JIRA SXE-3048/SXWEB-38216. Content:

properties.Label: Order Suffix
properties.Description: The order suffix of the line item. This field is loaded from the OEEH ordersuf. Content:

properties.Label: PO/WT #
properties.Help: Accum (P)O, Whse (T)ransfer In, (W)ork Order, or Blank
properties.Description: The order type of a line tie. This field indicates the source for filling the line item (a PO, WT, or work order).

properties.Label: OrigLine#
properties.Help: Original Line Number, Prior to Change of Product or UOM

properties.Label: Original Promised
properties.Description: The original promise date of a given order line. Defaults in from the promise date and can only be changed when the origpromisedtlockedfl is false and the user has security (sasoo.origpromisedtfl) and the sasoo setting for tracking promisedt at the line level is true. Content:

properties.Label: Old Stk Qty
properties.Description: The old stock quantity shipped when the line is accessed in change mode.

properties.Label: Override Type
properties.Description: This field contains an indicater to show if a line has a pricing record with tolerances and whether or not they were overriden. Content:

properties.Label: PD Rec #
properties.Description: The price/discounting record number (from PDSC) used to price this line item. If manual, previous, etc pricing is done, the pdrecno will be 0. If a PDSC record was used to price the line, the pdrecno is loaded from that PDSC record. This field in conjunction with the company number will allow direct access to the PDSC record. This direct access is used to update the actual quantity on a month/yearly accumulated PDSC record as well as to adjust for special costing (in p-oeeltm.i).

properties.Label: MSDS at Pick
properties.Description: MSDS Information from when the order was initiall picked Content:

properties.Label: Prev Qty Shp
properties.Description: The quantity that had been shipped at the time the last pick ticket was printed. This field starts out as 0 (since the order has not yet been picked). It remains 0 when the pick ticket is printed. Any time the quantity/unit on the line is maintained after picking, the prevqtyshp is loaded with the old stock quantity that was shipped. The prevqtyshp will not be overridden again until after the pick ticket is reprinted. This field controls the "Print Changes Only" option in picking. Content:

properties.Label: Price
properties.Description: The price of the line item. This field is stored per special costing unit if the product is specially costed. If not, the price is stored per unit on the line item. Content:

properties.Label: Price Level/C+ %
properties.Description: The price code stores additional price calculation information. Content:

properties.Label: Price Calc
properties.Description: The price calculation type describes how the price was calculated. It is stored as a blank for normal pricing and manually overridden pricing. If the F12 function key is accessed to do special pricing, the price calculation type will store the pricing method. Content:

properties.Label: PC
properties.Description: "Indicates where the price originated from - based upon base, list, price discounts level 1 thru 8, overridden price - up to 22 different codes." Content:

properties.Label: Price Over
properties.Description: If this flag is set to yes, it indicates the price has been manually overridden. This will occur when the price is typed in or when previous pricing is done. Content:

properties.Label: Price Type
properties.Description: The price type defines a group of products that are similarly priced. This field is used for PDSC level 2, 5, and 8 pricing. It is also used to group products for PDSS pricing.

properties.Label: Pick Tck Print
properties.Description: The print pick flag indicates if the pick ticket needs to be printed/reprinted for this line item. It defaults to yes for each new line added (indicating that a pick ticket needs to be printed for this line). When the pick ticket is printed, it is set to no. If any changes are made to the line item after picking, this field is reset to yes. This field in conjunction with the prevqtyshp control the "Print Changes Only" option on OEEPP. Content:

properties.Label: Print Invoice Price
properties.Description: The print price flag is an enterable field on the line item extended screen. This flag indicates if the product price/discount/net should be printed on the invoice and acknowledgement. When set to no, it is usually used in conjunction with the subtotalfl. A user may choose to suppress the price print on 3 lines and subtotal those 3 lines.

properties.Label: Category
properties.Description: The product category of the line item. On a stock product, this field defaults from ICSP. On a non-stock product, it defaults from ICAO. It is overrideable on the extended screen and the non-stock screen. G/L posting can be done by product category. Content:

properties.Label: Cost
properties.Description: The product cost of the line item. If the product is specially costed, this field is represented in the special costing units. If the product is not specially costed, this field is represented in the selling unit on the line item. On a stocked product, the prodcost defaults from the ICSW average, standard, replacement, or last cost plus addons (depending on what is appropriate as defined in ICAO in ChUI or AO-Product-Cost in GUI based on the S/M Cost assignment). p-oeetlc.i is the include that sets the cost. This cost is used for margin calculations.

properties.Label: Description
properties.Description: The product description of each non-stock product. This field is enterable on the non-stock screen for a non-stock product. The description for a stocked product is not stored on the line item since it is available in ICSP.

properties.Label: Line
properties.Description: This field represents the source product line for the line item. For a stocked product, it defaults from the ICSL ARP product line (if entered - regardless of the ARP type). For a non-stock product, it is the product line as entered on the non-stock screen. For a special order item, non-stock product, or drop line, this field may duplicate the oeel.arpprodline. Content:

properties.Label: Promised
properties.Description: The date this line item was promised to the customer. This field at the line level is only used on JIT orders (OEEH.orderdisp = "j"). It controls the picking timing of line items. If the order is not a JIT order, the OEEH.promisedt controls picking timing.

properties.Label: Promotional
properties.Description: The promotional flag is set when PDSC pricing is done. If the PDSC record used to price the line item was a promotional price record, the promofl will be set to yes. Otherwise it will be no. This field is not currently used in Trend reporting, but can be valuable through Results to determine thge effect of promotional pricing. Content:

properties.Label: Qty From Receivers
properties.Description: If the icsw.reservety = "a" or "r", the system will attempt to allocate inventory immediately. If there is not sufficient available inventory in stock (icsw.qtyonhand - icsw.qtycommit), then the program will attempt to commit inventory from received inventory (icsw.qtyrcvd). This field represents the quantity committed from the received inventory.

properties.Label: Ordered
properties.Description: The quantity of the product that was requested by the customer. This field is represented in the line item unit of measure. Content:

properties.Label: Qty Released
properties.Description: The quantity of a BL order that has been released on individual BRs. (These BRs can still be in entered stage.) This field is maintained from the F8-Release screen (from the banner).

properties.Label: Qty Returned
properties.Description: The quantity returned on a sales line indicates how many (in stocking units) of the product has been returned. This is updated with a return lines is tied to a sales line (F17 processing from line item entry).

properties.Label: Qty Ship
properties.Description: The quantity that was/will be shipped on the order. It is set to the available quantity when the order is entered and updated from back order fill.

properties.Label: Qty Unavailable
properties.Description: On a return line, the quantity returned that should not go into on hand but that should be into unavailable (if goods are damaged, etc). This field is represented in stocking units.

properties.Label: ShipVia
properties.Description: Quote Specific ShipVia

properties.Label: Reason
properties.Description: The reason unavailable type describes why there is unavailable quantity (qtyunavail) on the return. Content:

properties.Label: Replacement Cost
properties.Description: Special Pricing Agreement (SPA) replacement cost for order line.

properties.Label: Requested Prod
properties.Description: The requested product describes the product the customer originally requested. If a customer part number was entered (and cross referenced to a stocked product), the customer part number will be stored in the reqprod. Likewise, if a substitute or upgrade was done, the reqprod will store the originally requested product. This field is used to properly record usage when subs and upgrades are done. Content:

properties.Label: Requested
properties.Description: The date the customer requests shipment of the line. This field is used at the line level only on a JIT order (OEEH.orderdisp = "j"). The date the customer requests product can be distinguished from the date we promise delivery of the product (OEEL.promisedt).

properties.Label: Restock Charge
properties.Description: The restocking charge on a return line. This field defaults from the SASTA return reason setup. It accumulates into OEEH.totrestkamt.

properties.Label: Restock Type
properties.Description: The restockfl defines the restock charge as a % or $ amount. Content:

properties.Label: Restrict Changes
properties.Description: This field is used when interfacing with BP to restrict maintenance on a line created from BP. Content:

properties.Label: Return Credit
properties.Description: Added with JIRA SXE-3032/SXWEB-38188. This field contains the credit amount that will be refunded. This functionality allows a distributor to accept a product return and issue a refund of the original invoice amount, or issue a refund based on the original invoice amount minus the terms, or issue a refund based on the original amount actually paid. Usage of this logic requires AOData AR – ARAllowCreditDiscountsType and AR – ARAllowCreditDiscountsAddon settings. These can be found in AO – Customers – Cash Receipts – Discounts section – Allow Credit Discount fields. Type has the choices of Based on Amount Paid, Based on Terms, or Neither/blank. If Based on Amount Paid or Based on Terms is selected, the Addon field will display where a valid addon number can be selected. Content:

properties.Label: Return Line #
properties.Description: The return line number indicates the sales line this return is for. It will be loaded on a return line when the return is tied to a sales line via the F17 Return key. Content:

properties.Label: Return Order #
properties.Description: The return order number indicates the sales order attached to this return.
The return order suffix indicates the sale order suffix this return line was created from. Content:

properties.Label: Return
properties.Description: The return flag indicates that this line item is a return line item. It can be yes or no on the following order types: SO, CS, CR. The return flag is always set to yes on an RM and is always no on the other order types. The return flag displays as a "-" if the line is a return line. Content:

properties.Label: Return Type
properties.Description: The return type is used on a return line to indicate the disposition of the returned product. The return type can represent a vendor return, return of stock to unavailable (if damaged...), a return into stock, or a partial unavailable return (some of the return will go into stock and some will be set to unavailable). If a vendor return is selected, OEROW can be used to assist in identifying items that still need to be placed on a PO-RM. Content:

properties.Label: Row Pointer
properties.Description: A unique identifier that can be used to link other records to this particular record. Content:

properties.Label: Rush
properties.Help: If 'Yes', Then Line Will be Processed as Rush Order
properties.Description: The rush flag denotes that this item needs to be expedited to the customer. Generally this line will need to be purchased or transferred in. If this flag is set to yes, special handling on the PO and WT RRARs is allowed. Also, rush lines can be printed through the pick ticket prints ahead of non-rush lines. Additionally, a rush charge (line item addon) can be set to default in on a rush line (oeel.datccost). Content:

properties.Label: Territory
properties.Description: The sales territory is stored in OEEL to assist with the performance of Sales Manager reporting. It defaults straight from the ARSC and is not overrideable.

properties.Label: Scrap Loss Amount
properties.Help: Enter the Scrap Loss Amount for This Line
properties.Description: SXRF Cut Product Scrap Loss Amount

properties.Label: Service Shipment Type
properties.Description: Field Services interface loads the Line Type from the Planned Items. Customer types go to the cutomer site ahead of time based on the order's ship via. Inventory types load onto the technician's truck. Will show on SRO orders created from CSFS and will display on the pick ticket print if the AO option is set to allow printing of the SRO orders: Shipment Type: xxxxxxx Content:

properties.Label: Ship From
properties.Description: The ship from number is used when interfacing this OE line with a Purchase Order. The ship from number can be entered on a DO or tied line to indicated the vendor ship from you wish to purchase product from. Content:

properties.Label: Product
properties.Description: This is the primary product on the OE line. It indicates the product that was shipped to the customer (stock or non-stock).If a cross reference product was accessed, it is stored in oeel.reqprod.

properties.Label: Ship To
properties.Description: The customer ship to is stored in OEEL to assist with the performance of Sales Manager reports. It defaults from the ship to entered on the OE banner and is not overrideable at the line level. Content:

properties.Label: Ship Qty Over
properties.Description: This flag determines if the shipping quantity has been overridden. A ship quantity override will occur when the operator types a quantity in the shipped quantity that does not match the availability of the product. This flag is set in oeetlt.p.

properties.Label: Salesrep In
properties.Description: The inside sales rep defaults from the OE header (which defaults from ARSC/ARSS). It is overrideable on the line extended screen. The sales rep is used to update SMSS and for commission purposes. Content:

properties.Label: Out
properties.Description: The outside sales rep defaults from the OE header (which defaults from ARSC/ARSS). It is overrideable on the line extended screen. The sales rep field is used to update SMSS and for commission purposes. Content:

properties.Label: Spec/NS
properties.Description: The special/non-stock type describes the product/line disposition. It can be used to identify a non-stock product, special order item, or lost business line item. Each time the specnstype changes, OE treats the entry as a new product and all variables are reinitialized. Handling of the specnstype is done in oeetlns.p. Handling of the non-stock screen is done in oeetlnus.p. Non-Stock: the product is not stocked in this whse. All information about the product must be manually entered. Special order item: an "s" will be placed in the specnstype for all Order as Needed products (since they are not stocked). A stock item may also be specially ordered. This indicates that even if product is available, it should not be used to fill this order. Specials and non-stocks are picked up on the PO/WT RRARs. Lost business line: this is used to record demand for the product that is cancelled. It can be set at the line level or from a header order cancel. If the specnstype is set to "l", the lost business activity will be recorded in SMSW. Content:

properties.Label: Stat
properties.Description: The status type identifies the status of the line item. It is used to indicate if the line is still active, has been invoiced, or has been cancelled. Content:

properties.Label: Stk Qty Ord
properties.Description: The stock quantity ordered indicates how many stocking units have been ordered by the customer.

properties.Label: Ship Qty
properties.Description: The stock quantity shipped indicates how many stocking units will be/were shipped to the customer.

properties.Label: SubTotal Description
properties.Description: Stores the subtotal description.

properties.Label: Print Subtotal
properties.Description: The subtotal flag allows the operator to display a subtotalled net amount on the invoice and acknowledgement. It is usually used in conjunction with the printprcfl. If the subtotal flag is set to yes on line 5, the net amount will be subtotalled for every line above (to the first line or the a previous subtotal flag) and including line 5. Typically individual prices will not be printed for lines 1 through 5 and a subtotal after line 5 will print. Content:

properties.Label: SX Extract Dt
properties.Help: Date Transaction Was Extracted for Strategic Exchange

properties.Label: System Contract Number
properties.Description: The Contract # from the PD Record for the original system price calculated for this line.

properties.Label: System Price Effective Date
properties.Description: The Price Sheet Effective Date from the PD Record for the original system price calculated for this line.

properties.Label: System Pricing Cost Amt
properties.Description: The MarkUp Cost from when the system price was originally calculated. Content:

properties.Label: System Mark Up From Type
properties.Description: The MarkUp Cost Type from when the system price was originally calculated. AO Cost MarkUp: ICSW Cost + addons if set to include Content:

properties.Label: System PD Rec#
properties.Description: The PD Record # for the original system price calculated for this line.

properties.Label: System Price
properties.Description: The original system price calculated for this line.

properties.Label: System Based On Amount
properties.Description: Depends on the Based On Type. It can carry a pricing cost, or a system price (base or list)

properties.Label: System Based On Type
properties.Description: The PDSC Based On for the original system price calculated for this line. Content:

properties.Label: System Price Sheet
properties.Description: The Price Sheet from the PD Record for the original system price calculated for this line.

properties.Label: System Price Reference
properties.Description: The Reference from the PD Record for the original system price calculated for this line.

properties.Label: HS Code
properties.Description: Harmonized System Tariff Code. The HS system uses a logical nomenclature method to categorize goods into approximately 5,000 commodity groups. Countries often assign customs duties based on the harmonized tariff code of the product. Included on the Commercial Invoice created from OEROC. Content:

properties.Label: Taxable
properties.Description: The taxable flag indicates if this line is a taxable line item. It defaults according to the combination of the customer and product taxing statuses.

properties.Label: Taxable Type
properties.Description: Used by Australia.

properties.Label: Tax Adjustment
properties.Help: If 'Yes', Labor will be Treated as a Tax Adjustment
properties.Description: The tax adjustment flag gives the user a way to differentiate when entering labor on correction sales orders. The taxadjfl indicates whether labor is being used for tax correction reasons or if actual labor is being adjusted. If 'Yes', Labor will be Treated as a Tax Adjustment.

properties.Label: Tax Amount
properties.Description: This field shows the tax amount for the line item

properties.Label: Group
properties.Help: 1 - 5 (1 for Standard Tax or 1 for Vertex)
properties.Description: The tax group is used to identify the tax rate that applies to this line item. The taxsaleamt is stored in the header to accumulate the net amount to be taxed for each tax group. It is indexed by the tax group. Content:

properties.Label: Terms Discount %
properties.Description: The terms percent can be entered at the line level to allow for special terms discounts for a product. It defaults from PDSC or ICSP if the SASTA terms type is line based. The net amount is accumulated in the termslineamt at the header level for line based terms.

properties.Label: Last Change Date
properties.Description: Records the date when a given record was last changed. Last changed is defined by an operator pressing GO from a setup screen, or the completion of a batch processing transaction.

properties.Label: Trans Proc
properties.Description: The function to last update this record

properties.Label: Last Change Time
properties.Description: This is the time portion of the last date/time a given record was changed. Record changed is defined by either an operator pressing GO from a setup screen, or the completion of a processing transaction (ie. Invoiced OE line) in batch type functions.

properties.Label: Type
properties.Help: SO, DO, FO, ST, CS, CR, QU, BL, or RM
properties.Description: The transaction type is stored at the line level in order to enhance report/inquiry performance. It defaults from the OE header and is not overrideable. (See the definition for OEEH.transtype)

properties.Label: Units
properties.Description: The unit describes the selling unit of measure. It defaults from the ICSW selling unit and can be changed. Validation of the unit in ICSEU or SASTA will set the conversion factor (oeel.unitconv) for the line item. Content:

properties.Label: # Stk Units
properties.Description: The unit conversion factor indicates the number of stocking units in a selling unit. If there at 24 stocking units in a case, the unitconv would be = 24. If we are selling 1/6 of a stocking unit, the unitconv would be = .16667. This field is used to set the stkqtyord and stkqtyship in order to update ICSW in stocking units. Content:

properties.Label: Usage
properties.Description: The usage flag is used to determine if usage in ICSWU should be updated for this line item. It is defaulted in the following manner: no - a labor product - a non-stock line - a special order item that is not an order as needed product - a stock product on a DO order yes - all other combinations The usage flag is overrideable on the line extended screen. (It is not overrideable on a labor product, non-stock product, lost business line, or core return). When a line is invoiced, an ICET record is created. The ICET record contains a usagefl and mergedfl. ICAM uses ICET record to record used. If the ICET mergedfl = no and ICET usagefl = yes, ICAM will use this ICET record to record usage in ICSWU. properties.Label: Vendor #
properties.Description: The vendno field describes the source vendor for the line item. On a stocked product, it is loaded from the ICSW ARP vendor (regardless of the ARP type). On a non-stock product, it is loaded from the vendor entered on the non-stock screen. For a special order item, non-stock, or line drop, this field may duplicate oeel.arpvendno.

properties.Label: Vendor Quote
properties.Description: Special Pricing Agreement (SPA) vendor quote for order line.

properties.Label: Warranty Exchange
properties.Description: The warranty exchange flag is set on the return and sale lines of a warranty exchange. This feature can be used when returning a line if the return type is set up in SASTA as a warranty exchange, which will create a sales line from the return line with a 0 price and cost. Content:

properties.Label: Warranty Stage
properties.Description: The warranty stage code is used to track the processing of warranty products to the vendor. After a return line is entered, the OEROW report can be run to display lines that need to be placed on POs. Once the PO has been placed and the PO line tied the the sales line, the warranty stage is updated. It is also incremented when credit is received from the vendor. Content:

properties.Label: Warranty Tag #
properties.Help: Warranty Tag is Required for This Credit Memo Reason (5039)
properties.Description: The warranty tag number for the warranty return. Vendors may require a warranty tag to be placed on a product to be returned to the vendor. Warranty tag entry can be required based on the SASTA setup for the return reason.

properties.Label: Weight
properties.Description: The weight of the line item. This field defaults from ICSP for stocked products and is 0 for non-stocks. Content:

properties.Label: Whse
properties.Description: The whse from which product is sold. This field defaults from the banner whse and is not overrideable. It is used to control whse pricing and ICSW updates.

properties.Label: Whse Mgr Qty Ship
properties.Description: The Warehouse Manager quantity shipped controls bin location entry on the line item. If the product is WM controlled, the proper quantities per bin must be entered prior to invoicing the order. When the wtqtyship = stkqtyship on a WM controlled line, this line is ready for invoicing.

properties.Label: WO Disc
properties.Description: The whole order discount amount represents the amount of the header WO discount that is prorated to the line during OEEPI. This field is used to update G/L for the WO discount. It is also used on some SM reports to display a fully discounted price.

properties.Label: Force Word Index Rebuild
properties.Description: A logical flag that can be assigned opposite of the current value forcing a rebuild of the word index entry for this record. Content:

properties.Label: WT Company
properties.Description: The Warehouse Transfer Company is currently not used. It is intended to allow an OE interface to a cross company transfer. Content:

properties.Label: Cross Ref Type
properties.Description: The cross reference product type is used to describe what is in the OEEL.reqprod (the cross reference product). If a cross reference product is selected (customer product, sub, supersede...), the xrefprodty will be loaded. This field is used to display the cross reference description on the invoice and acknowledgement. Content:

properties.Label: ARP Line
properties.Description: The product line or warehouse this product is sourced from. This field is only loaded for non-stock products, special order items, and drop ship lines. For a non-stock product, this field is enterable on the non-stock screen. If the ARP whse on the non-stock screen is entered, the arpprodline will contain the whse and the arpvendno will be 0. If the ARP whse is not entered on the non-stock screen, the arpprodline will contain the product line entered on the non-stock screen. For a stocked product, this field defaults from either the ARP whse (if the ARP is a whse) or the ARP product line set in ICSW. This field is used for special and non-stock lines that need to be picked up on a RRAR. Content:

properties.Label: ARP Vendor #
properties.Description: The ARP vendor number is used to indicate who the line is sourced from (if sourced from a vendor). It is only loaded on a non-stock product, special order line, or drop ship line. On a non-stock, it is loaded with the vendor entered on the non-stock screen. For a stocked special or DO line, it is loaded with the ARP vendor from ICSW. If the line is a DO line or tied line, the vendor is overrideable from the F6 function key on the extended screen. If no vendor exists in ICSW, this field will contain a 0. Content:

properties.Label: Batch
properties.Description: The batch name is the key to this record with the company and sequence number. These fields tie one batch together. Content:

properties.Label: B/O
properties.Description: The back order type for the order. This field defaults to "d" on a DO order, "y" if the customer accepts back orders, or "n" if the customer does not accept back orders. Content:

properties.Label: Added From Catalog
properties.Description: Indicates if an order as needed product was added from the catalog when this line was added. If the product was not set up when the line was added but was defined in the catalog file, the operator has the option to create an ICSP/ICSW record automatically. If the new records are created, this flag is set to yes. If the catalog product is pulled into the order as a non-stock product, this flag remains no. OERE reports all products added from the catalog file as lines are added. Content:

properties.Label: Charge Qty
properties.Description: The charge quantity for a catch weight product. This field is enterable on the extended screen in OEES. It is used to reprice/cost the line items based on the weight of the line. (NOTE: we now longer allow entry of a catch weight product in ICSP as of V3.0. Keep all code intact in case we reestablish this functionality.) Content:

properties.Label: Commission
properties.Description: Describes whether the commission amount is a % or a $. Content:

properties.Label: Company #
properties.Description: Identifies the Company under which the record was created.

properties.Label: Core Charge
properties.Description: The core charge for the product. This charge defaults to the line item from ICSP. It is expressed in the selling unit of measure.

properties.Label: Core Charge
properties.Description: The core charge type. If the line is eligible for a core charge (ICSP core charge is > 0), the core charge will be enterable from the extended screen. A core can also be returned. This field distinguishes between the 3 situations. Content:

properties.Label: Cost Over
properties.Description: The cost override flag indicates if the cost has been manually entered. Content:

properties.Label: Credit Memo Reason
properties.Description: The credit reason type. If this field is entered on the banner on a CR or RM order, it will default to the line item. It can be overridden on a return line when F17 is pressed to return a line. Content:

properties.Label: DATC
properties.Description: The "destination area transportation charge" for this line item represented in the selling unit. The field was originally established to be a datc cost. It has since be expanded (V4.5) to be a line addon charge. The label of the cost is user defined. If it is defined in ICAO, this charge can be entered (and will default from ICSW). This field is used to pass an additional charge to the customer based on the product sold and how it is sold (IE: if the product was rushed to the customer). Content:

properties.Label: Discount
properties.Description: The discount amount of the line item. This field is represented in the selling unit of measure (if the product is a specially costed product, this field is represented in the special costing unit). The discount amount can be calculated from the PDSC setup (and is thus a % discount). It can also be manually overridden and set to a $ discount.

properties.Label: Discount Type
properties.Description: The discount type for the line item. It indicates if the discount is a percent or a dollar. Either way, both the discamt and discpct are calculated and stored. Content:

properties.Label: Entered
properties.Description: The date the order was added. When a back order is created, the enter date is reset to the date the back order is created.

properties.Label: G.S.T. Status
properties.Description: This field is used for Canadian taxes. Content:

properties.Label: Spec Rec Link
properties.Help: Special Price/Cost Record Number for Link to Transactions
properties.Description: This field will identify the special price/costing data that is related to this record. This number can be matched up to the ICSS record with the primary unique key k-icss.

properties.Label: JIT Picked
properties.Description: This flag indicates that a "just in time" line item has been picked. JIT orders are established by an orderdisp of "j". Only lines that should be picked based on the promise date of the line item will be picked. When these lines are picked, the jitpickfl will be set to yes. Once the line is set to yes, it qualifies for shipping and invoicing. The lines not picked will move to a new release when the lines that have been picked are invoiced. Content:

properties.Label: Job #
properties.Description: The job number on the line item. This number defaults from the job number attached to the ARSS record. If a job number exists on the PDSC record that is used for pricing, it will override the ARSS job number. This field prints on the PO and WT RRAR reports.

properties.Label: Lead Time
properties.Description: The lead time is enterable on all order types on the extended screen. It is used to update OEEH.longltdays - this number represents the line with the longest lead time. If is line with the longest lead time is deleted or the lead time is changed to under longltdays, the longltdays is not decremented. Content:

properties.Label: Line#
properties.Description: The line number of the order entry line. This field is automatically incremented each time a line is added. It is loaded from oeeh.nextlineno.

properties.Label: Net Amt
properties.Description: The net amount of the line item. This field is used to roll up to the totlineamt on the order. It is the fully extended price of the line. Content:

properties.Label: Non Tax Reason
properties.Description: The non tax type indicates why a line is not taxable. If the order is not taxable, this field defaults from the header non tax reason. If the product is not taxable, it defaults from the ICSW non tax reason. Otherwise it is set to the header non tax reason. Content:

properties.Label: Last Change By
properties.Description: Tags the record with the login initials of the last operator to update the record. Last update is defined by the operator pressing GO on a setup screen, or by the completion of a transaction in a batch updating process.

properties.Label: PO/WT/WO #
properties.Help: "P" for Accumulative PO or "T" for Transfer In or Blank
properties.Description: The order type of a line tie. This field indicates the source for filling the line item (a PO, WT, or work order). Content:

properties.Label: Price
properties.Description: The price of the line item. This field is stored per special costing unit if the product is specially costed. If not, the price is stored per unit on the line item. Content:

properties.Label: Price Over
properties.Description: If this flag is set to yes, it indicates the price has been manually overridden. This will occur when the price is typed in or when previous pricing is done. Content:

properties.Label: Print Invoice Price
properties.Description: The print price flag is an enterable field on the line item extended screen. This flag indicates if the product price/discount/net should be printed on the invoice and acknowledgement. Content:

properties.Label: Category
properties.Description: The product category of the line item. On a stock product, this field defaults from ICSP. On a non-stock product, it defaults from OEAO. It is overrideable on the extended screen and the non-stock screen. G/L posting can be done by product category. Content:

properties.Label: Cost
properties.Description: The product cost of the line item. If the product is specially costed, this field is represented in the special costing units. If the product is not specially costed, this field is represented in the selling unit on the line item. On a stocked product, the prodcost defaults from the ICSW average, standard, replacement, or last cost plus addons (depending on what is appropriate as defined in ICAO). p-oeetlc.i is the include that sets the cost.

properties.Label: Description
properties.Description: The product description of each non-stock product. This field is enterable on the non-stock screen for a non-stock product. The description for a stocked product is not stored on the line item since it is available in ICSP.

properties.Label: Line
properties.Description: This field represents the source product line for the line item. For a stocked product, it defaults from the ICSL ARP product line (if entered - regardless of the ARP type). For a non-stock product, it is the product line as entered on the non-stock screen. For a special order item, non-stock product, or drop line, this field may duplicate the oeel.arpprodline. Content:

properties.Label: Promise Date
properties.Description: The date this line item was promised to the customer. This field at the line level is only used on JIT orders (OEEH.orderdisp = "j"). It controls the picking timing of line items. If the order is not a JIT order, the OEEH.promisedt controls picking timing.

properties.Label: Ordered
properties.Description: The quantity of the product that was requested by the customer. This field is represented in the line item unit of measure. Content:

properties.Label: Unavailable
properties.Description: On a return line, the quantity returned that should not go into on hand but that should be into unavailable (if goods are damaged, etc). This field is represented in stocking units.

properties.Label: ShipVia
properties.Description: Quote Specific ShipVia

properties.Label: Reason
properties.Description: The reason unavailable type describes why there is unavailable quantity (qtyunavail) on the return. Content:

properties.Label: Requested
properties.Description: The date the customer requests shipment of the line. This field is used at the line level only on a JIT order (OEEH.orderdisp = "j"). The date the customer requests product can be distinguished from the date we promise delivery of the product (OEEL.promisedt).

properties.Label: Restock Charge
properties.Description: The restocking charge on a return line. This field defaults from the SASTA return reason setup. It accumulates into OEEH.totrestkamt.

properties.Label: Return
properties.Description: The return flag indicates that this line item is a return line item. It can be yes or no on the following order types: SO, CS, CR. The return flag is always set to yes on an RM and is always no on the other order types. The return flag displays as a "-" if the line is a return line. Content:

properties.Label: Rush
properties.Help: If 'Yes', Then Line Will be Processed as a Rush Order
properties.Description: The rush flag denotes that this item needs to be expedited to the customer. Generally this line will need to be purchased or transferred in. If this flag is set to yes, special handling on the PO and WT RRARs is allowed. Also, rush lines can be printed through the pick ticket prints ahead of non-rush lines. Additionally, a rush charge (line item addon) can be set to default in on a rush line (oeel.datccost). Content:

properties.Label: Seq #
properties.Description: The sequence number is used as part of the primary key with company, batch name, and line number to uniquely identify an order within a batch.

properties.Label: Ship From
properties.Description: The ship from number is used when interfacing this OE line with a Purchase Order. The ship from number can be entered on a DO or tied line to indicated the vendor ship from you wish to purchase product from. Content:

properties.Label: Product
properties.Description: This is the primary product on the OE line. It indicates the product that was shipped to the customer (stock or non-stock).If a cross reference product was accessed, it is stored in oeel.reqprod. Content:

properties.Label: Salesrep In
properties.Description: The inside sales rep defaults from the OE header (which defaults from ARSC/ARSS). It is overrideable on the line extended screen. The sales rep is used to update SMSS and for commission purposes. Content:

properties.Label: Out
properties.Description: The outside sales rep defaults from the OE header (which defaults from ARSC/ARSS). It is overrideable on the line extended screen. The sales rep field is used to update SMSS and for commission purposes. Content:

properties.Label: Spec/NS
properties.Description: The special/non-stock type describes the product/line disposition. It can be used to identify a non-stock product, special order item, or lost business line item. Each time the specnstype changes, OE treats the entry as a new product and all variables are reinitialized. Handling of the specnstype is done in oeetlns.p. Handling of the non-stock screen is done in oeetlnus.p. Non-Stock: the product is not stocked in this whse. All information about the product must be manually entered. Special order item: an "s" will be placed in the specnstype for all Order as Needed products (since they are not stocked). A stock item may also be specially ordered. This indicates that even if product is available, it should not be used to fill this order. Specials and non-stocks are picked up on the PO/WT RRARs. Lost business line: this is used to record demand for the product that is cancelled. It can be set at the line level or from a header order cancel. If the specnstype is set to "l", the lost business activity will Content:

properties.Label: Stk Qty Ord
properties.Description: The stock quantity ordered indicates how many stocking units have been ordered by the customer. Content:

properties.Label: Print Subtotal
properties.Description: The subtotal flag allows the operator to display a subtotalled net amount on the invoice and acknowledgement. It is usually used in conjunction with the printprcfl. If the subtotal flag is set to yes on line 5, the net amount will be subtotalled for every line above (to the first line or the a previous subtotal flag) and including line 5. Typically individual prices will not be printed for lines 1 through 5 and a subtotal after line 5 will print. Content:

properties.Label: Taxable
properties.Description: The taxable flag indicates if this line is a taxable line item. It defaults according to the combination of the customer and product taxing statuses. Content:

properties.Label: Group
properties.Description: The tax group is used to identify the tax rate that applies to this line item. The taxsaleamt is stored in the header to accumulate the net amount to be taxed for each tax group. It is indexed by the tax group. Content:

properties.Description: The terms percent can be entered at the line level to allow for special terms discounts for a product. It defaults from PDSC or ICSP if the SASTA terms type is line based. The net amount is accumulated in the termslineamt at the header level for line based terms.

properties.Description: The unit describes the selling unit of measure. It defaults from the ICSW selling unit and can be changed. Validation of the unit in ICSEU or SASTA will set the conversion factor (oeel.unitconv) for the line item. Content:

properties.Description: The usage flag is used to determine if usage in ICSWU should be updated for this line item. It is defaulted in the following manner: no - a labor product - a non-stock line - a special order item that is not an order as needed product - a stock product on a DO order yes - all other combinations The usage flag is overrideable on the line extended screen. properties.Label: Line#
properties.Description: The line number of the order entry line. This field is automatically incremented each time a line is added. It is loaded from oeeh.nextlineno (and oeeh.nextlineno on the -00 suffix is incremented each time a line is added to any suffix of the order). The line number is carried to all back orders and releases. For instance, if lines 1 and 2 are fully filled and line 3 back orders onto the -01 suffix, it will carry line "3" to the back order.

properties.Label: Order #
properties.Description: The order number of the order. This is the primary key.

properties.Label: Order Suffix
properties.Description: The order suffix of the order. The -00 always indicates the original order. Any other order can be a back order or a release, depending on the order type. Only a BR and jit order can have releases with suffixes greater that -00. The borelfl indicates if the suffix is a back order or not. Back orders are created through oeetbo.p

properties.Label: Restriction Code
properties.Description: Storing data pulled from ICSPR (restrictcd) if a product restriction is found. The only way a 'Not Allowed' restriction code can be stored on the line item is if the operator performs a override. Otherwise, the restriction code stored is an 'Allowed' restriction.

properties.Label: Restriction Description
properties.Description: If the oeelextra.restrictcd is loaded, then it will pull in and store the description from sasta.descrip (sasta.codeiden = RC).

properties.Label: Restriction Override Comment
properties.Description: If a product restriction is found, and it is a 'Not Allowed' and the operator atcually overrode the restriction in line entry, the system will store a comment that the operator is required to enter along with the override flag.

properties.Label: Restriction Override
properties.Description: If a product restriction is found, and it is a 'Not Allowed' and the operator atcually overrode the restriction in line entry, the system will store that this restriction (restrictcd) has been overridden (restrictovrfl). It will be used to flag the line and be able to report or inquiry looking for overridden restrictions.

properties.Label: Alt Whse
properties.Description: The alternate warehouse if an alternate warehouse is selected. If the OEAO alternate warehouse flag is set to yes, the operator may select an alternate warehouse when it is displayed with substitutes and upgrades when the ordering warehouse is short stock. Selection of the secondary warehouse allows stock to be reserved in the alternate warehouse and transferred (a WT is generated in OEEPI) to the selling warehouse. All pricing/costing is per the selling warehouse. The alternate warehouse just provides the capability to do an automatic transfer. Content:

properties.Label: ARP Line
properties.Description: The ARP prodline is used for a non-stock or special order component that is sourced from a Vendor. If a prodline is entered, a valid vendor must also be entered. Content:

properties.Label: ARP Vendor #
properties.Description: The ARP Vendno is used for a non-stock or special order components that is sourced from a Vendor. Content:

properties.Label: ARP Whse
properties.Description: The ARP Whse is used for a non-stock or special order component that is source from a warehouse. If the non-stock is also sourced from a vendor through the ARP Whse, the arpvendno and arpprodline will also be loaded. Content:

properties.Label: Added From Catalog
properties.Description: Indicates if an order as needed product was added from the catalog when this line was added. If the product was not set up when the line was added but was defined in the catalog file, the operator has the option to create an ICSP/W record automatically. If the new records are created, this flag is set to yes. If the catalog product is pulled into the order as a non-stock product, this flag remains no. OERE reports all components added from the catalog file as lines are added. Content:

properties.Label: Customer Cost
properties.Description: The cost of a pre-built kit component product that has been identified as customer owned inventory in a storeroom mananged warehouse. Since the customer already owns the inventory, the cost of the component that is being used will be zero. This field tracks the value of the customer owned kit component product. The value of the components can then be rolled up to find the value of the kit that was built.

properties.Label: Customer #
properties.Description: The customer on the order. Content:

properties.Label: Customer Quantity
properties.Description: Both distributor owned component products and customer owned component products may be used in the assembly of a pre-built kit in a storeroom managed warehouse. This field is used to track the number of customer owned component products that were used.

properties.Label: Group Name
properties.Description: The name of the group/option this component was loaded from. It is used for delete purposes (to delete a full group or option). Content:
