properties.Description: User defined field.

properties.Label: User 9
properties.Description: User defined field.

properties.Label: VA Order#
properties.Description: The value add transaction# for this transaction. This is the primary key for the file. Content:

properties.Label: VA Order Suffix
properties.Description: The value add order suffix of the transaction. The -00 always indicates the original order. Any other suffix for a given value add transaction# will be a backorder. Content:

properties.Label: WLET Set#
properties.Help: The PAK WLET Record Passed From WL, Needed To Complete

properties.Label: Force Word Index Rebuild
properties.Description: A logical flag that can be assigned opposite of the current value forcing a rebuild of the word index entry for this record. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: ARP Line

properties.Label: ARP Line
properties.Description: The ARP product line this product is sourced from. This field is only loaded for non-stock products, special order items, and drop ship lines. For a non-stock product, this field is enterable on the non-stock screen. For a stocked product, this field defaults from the ARP product line in ICSW. This field is used for special and non-stock lines that need to be picked up on a RRAR. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: ARP Vendor #

properties.Label: ARP Vendor #
properties.Description: The ARP vendor number is used to indicate who the line is sourced from (if sourced from a vendor). It is only loaded on a non-stock product, special order line, or drop ship line. On a non-stock, it is loaded with the vendor entered on the non-stock screen. For a stocked special or DO line, it is loaded with the ARP vendor from ICSW. If the line is a DO line or tied line, the vendor is overrideable from the Extend screen. If no vendor exists in ICSW, this field will contain a 0. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: ARP Whse

properties.Label: ARP Whse
properties.Description: The ARP Whse is used for a non-stock or special order line item that is source from a warehouse. If the non-stock is also sourced from a vendor through the ARP Whse, the arpvendno and arpprodline will also be loaded. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Bin Location

properties.Label: Bin Location
properties.Description: The bin location for the product. This field is loaded during picking when pick tickets are printed in bin location order.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: BO Seq#

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Cancellation Type

properties.Label: Cancellation Type
properties.Description: Value Add Fabrication Assembly Line Cancellation Type Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Added From Catalog

properties.Label: Added From Catalog
properties.Description: Indicates if an order as needed product was added from the catalog when this line was added. If the product was not set up when the line was added but was defined in the catalog file, the operator has the option to create an ICSP/W record automatically. If the new records are created, this flag is set to yes. If the catalog product is pulled into the order as a non-stock product, this flag remains no. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items

properties.Description: The comment flag for the line item. If a comment exists on the line (stored in COM based on the order/suffix/line), a "c" will display to the left of the line item on the Value Add Entry screen. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Completed Flag

properties.Label: Completed Flag
properties.Description: This flag indicates if the value add transaction section, that contains the line item, is completed or not. This flag is part of indexes to allow quicker access to open sections. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Company #

properties.Label: Company #
properties.Description: Identifies the Company under which the record was created.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Cost Over

properties.Label: Cost Over
properties.Description: The cost override flag indicates if the cost has been manually entered. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Cube

properties.Label: Cube
properties.Description: The number of cubic units for a single stocking qty of the product on the line item. This field defaults from ICSP for stocked products and can be entered for non-stocks. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Cutoff Type

properties.Label: Cutoff Type
properties.Description: Value Add Fabrication Assembly cutoff type

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Direct Order Flag

properties.Label: Direct Order Flag
properties.Description: This field indicates if the inventory component line item should be acquired on a Direct Order (DO) purchase order or warehouse transfer. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Extended Cubes

properties.Label: Extended Cubes
properties.Description: The number of cubic units for the entire line item. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Extended Weight

properties.Label: Extended Weight
properties.Description: The weight for the entire line item. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Spec Rec Link

properties.Label: Spec Rec Link
properties.Help: Special Price/Cost Record Number for Link to Transactions
properties.Description: This field will identify the special price/costing data that is related to this record. This number can be matched up to the ICSS record with the primary unique key k-icss.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Intermediate Product Flag

properties.Label: Intermediate Product Flag
properties.Description: Intermediate product flag. This field indicates if the value add transaction inventory component line item is an intermediate product, from an external or internal processing section. This is needed by the PO/WT RRAR functions to not select this line item, since the line item will be a non-stock product. This intermediate line item is only used to ship the intermediate product to the next processing step. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Word Index

properties.Label: Word Index
properties.Description: Internal field used for keyword processing

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Labor Flat Rate Flag

properties.Label: Labor Flat Rate Flag
properties.Description: This is the labor flat rate flag. If the line item is contained on an External processing section, then the line items must be labor products. The charge associated with this line item can be considered a flat rate (doesn't matter how much of the finished product is produced), or not a flat rate (extended cost of the line item is based on the units produced). Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Labor Type

properties.Label: Labor Type
properties.Description: If the line item is not a flat rate charge (vaesl.laborflatrtfl = no), then the labor type field is used to specify what the charge is based upon, with respect to the finished product.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Labor Units

properties.Label: Labor Units
properties.Description: If the line item is not a flat rate charge (vaesl.laborflatrtfl = no) then the labor type indicates what the charge is based (Qty, Weight, or Cube). The labor units contain eight the qty, weight, or cube of the finished product that the charge will be based. Example: Labor Chrg Labor Type Labor Units Units Finished product Total $50 Q 100 2000 $1000 $250 W 100 500 $1250 $75 C 50 150 $225 Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Lead Time

properties.Label: Lead Time
properties.Description: The time in days required to replenish the component product. This can be used to determine when the completed product will be available. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Variable Length Component

properties.Label: Variable Length Component
properties.Description: VA Fabrication Assembly - Identifies the Variable Length Line

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Line # Alternate

properties.Label: Line # Alternate
properties.Description: The line alternate number indicates the PO, WT or VA line that this order is tied to. This field is not enterable from VAET but is updated when the PO/WT/VA line is created from the order (on a drop line or a tie). Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Line#

properties.Label: Line#
properties.Description: This is the line number of the line item within the value add transaction section. It is assigned by the system and is not accessable to the user for changing. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Maximum Labor Calc Qty

properties.Label: Maximum Labor Calc Qty
properties.Description: Value Add Fabrication Assembly max labor calc qty

label: Net GL Amount

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Non Stock

properties.Label: Non Stock
properties.Description: This field indicates if the product for this line item is a Non Stock product ("N"), Special Order product ("S") or regular stock product (blank). Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: # Times Chg

properties.Label: # Times Chg
properties.Description: The number of times a line item has been changed. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Last Change By

properties.Label: Last Change By
properties.Description: Tags the record with the login initials of the last operator to update the record. Last update is defined by the operator pressing GO on a setup screen, or by the completion of a transaction in a batch updating process.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Original Qty Based On Total

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Original Qty Needed

properties.Label: Original Qty Needed
properties.Description: Original Qty Needed Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Related Order #

properties.Label: Related Order #
properties.Description: The alternate order number indicates the PO/WT/VA number that the line item is tied to. This number is enterable on the extended screen of the line item. If the line item is a drop ship, or tie, the PO/WT number can be automatically generated when go is pressed from the line item. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: PO/WT Type

properties.Label: PO/WT Type
properties.Description: The Order Alt Type of a line tie. This field indicates the source for filling the line item (a PO, WT, or VA).

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Prev Qty Ship

properties.Label: Prev Qty Ship
properties.Description: The quantity that had been shipped at the time the last pick ticket was printed. This field starts out as 0 (since the order has not yet been picked). It remains 0 when the pick ticket is printed. Any time the quantity/unit on the line is maintained after picking, the prevqtyshp is loaded with the old stock quantity that was shipped. The prevqtyshp will not be overridden again until after the pick ticket is reprinted. This field controls the "Print Changes Only" option in picking.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Prev WIP Flag

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Pick Ticket Print

properties.Label: Pick Ticket Print
properties.Description: The print pick flag indicates if the pick ticket needs to be printed/reprinted for this line item. It defaults to yes for each new line added (indicating that a pick ticket needs to be printed for this line). When the pick ticket is printed, it is set to no. If any changes are made to the line item after picking, this field is reset to yes. This field in conjunction with the prevqtyshp control the "Print Changes Only" option on VAEPP. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Category

properties.Label: Category
properties.Description: The product category of the line item. On a stock product, this field defaults from ICSP. On a non-stock product, it defaults from ICAO. It is overrideable on the non-stock screen. G/L posting can be done by product category. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Cost

properties.Label: Cost
properties.Description: The product cost of the line item. If the product is specially costed, this field is represented in the special costing units. If the product is not specially costed, this field is represented in the selling unit on the line item. On a stocked product, the prodcost defaults from the ICSW average, standard, replacement, or last cost plus addons (depending on what is appropriate as defined in ICAO).

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Description

properties.Label: Description
properties.Description: The product description of each non-stock product. This field is enterable on the non-stock screen for a non-stock product. The description for a stocked product is not stored on the line item since it is available in ICSP.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Description 2

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Qty Based On Total

properties.Label: Qty Based On Total
properties.Description: This field indicates if the total quantity for this line item is based on the total units produced of the finished product. In most cases, the line items for the inventory components section would have the total quantity based on the units produced (recipe format). Although there may be cases where inventory is to be specified on the ork order, but the amount of that product isn't based on the units produced. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Qty Needed

properties.Label: Qty Needed
properties.Description: This is the qty needed for this line item. This would be how much of this component is needed to make one stocking qty of the finished product. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Ordered

properties.Label: Ordered
properties.Description: This is the total qty for this line item. It is calculated as follows: If the quantity based on total flag = yes, then it's the quantity needed * quantity ordered (vaeh.stkqtyord) of the finished product If the quantity based on total flag = no, then it's simply the quantity needed. The quantity ordered is related to the line item unit of measure. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Qty Ship

properties.Label: Qty Ship
properties.Description: This is the total quantity shipped for this line item. For a stocked product, it is based on the ICSW availability. For a non-stock product, it is the quantity that has been acquired from a vendor or another warehouse and has been filled for this line item. The quantity shipped is related to the line item's unit of measure. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items

properties.Description: On an Inventory In section line item, the quantity returned that should not go into On Hand but that should be into unavailable (if goods are damaged, etc). This field is represented in stocking units.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Reason Unavailable

properties.Label: Reason Unavailable
properties.Description: The reason unavailable type describes why there is unavailable quantity (qtyunavail) on the Inventory In section line item. Content:

properties.Label: Section Type
properties.Description: Value add transaction section type. Each transaction section will contain one of the allowable section types (not user defined). Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Seq#

properties.Label: Seq#
properties.Description: Value add transaction section sequence#. Each value add section for a given transaction is assigned a unique sequence#. The sections are listed in this sequence order. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Product

properties.Label: Product
properties.Description: This is the primary product on the VA line. It indicates the product for that line item (stock or non-stock). Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Ship Qty Over

properties.Label: Ship Qty Over
properties.Description: This flag determines if the shipping quantity has been overridden. A ship quantity override will occur when the operator types a quantity in the shipped quantity that does not match the availability of the product.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Status

properties.Label: Status
properties.Description: The status type identifies the status of the line item. It is used to indicate if the line is still active, or has been cancelled or completed Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Stk Qty Ord

properties.Label: Stk Qty Ord
properties.Description: This is the stocking quantity ordered for this line item.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Ship Qty

properties.Label: Ship Qty
properties.Description: This is the stocking quantity shipped for this line item, based on the unit of measure.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Actual Type

properties.Label: Actual Type
properties.Description: This field is used for a line item for an Internal Process or Inspection section. It is used to indicate if the line item is considered time entered as Estimated or Actual.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Comment

properties.Label: Comment
properties.Description: This field is used for a line item for an Internal Process or Inspection section. It is used to store a comment field that can be entered when time information is entered in VAEL (similar to our CMEJ Comment field). Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Elapsed Time

properties.Label: Elapsed Time
properties.Description: This field is used for a line item for an Internal process or Inspection section. This field stores the time entered as total number of seconds. The user enters hours and minutes for their estimated or actual time, but the data is stored as number of seconds. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Sales Rep

properties.Label: Sales Rep
properties.Description: This field is used for a line item for an Internal process or Inspection section. This is the operator's initials for the line item representing estimated or actual time. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Work Date

properties.Label: Work Date
properties.Description: This field is used for a line item for an Internal process or Inspection section. This field contains the date when the actual time was incurred. Content:

properties.Description: This is the time portion of the last date/time a given record was changed. Record changed is defined by either an operator pressing GO from a setup screen, or the completion of a processing transaction (ie. Invoiced OE line) in batch type functions.

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Units

properties.Label: Units
properties.Description: The unit describes the selling unit of measure. It defaults from the ICSW selling unit and can be changed. Validation of the unit in ICSEU or SASTA will set the conversion factor (vaesl.unitconv) for the line item. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: # Stk Units

properties.Label: # Stk Units
properties.Description: The unit conversion factor indicates the number of stocking units in a selling unit. If there at 24 stocking units in a case, the unitconv would be = 24. If we are selling 1/6 of a stocking unit, the unitconv would be = .16667. This field is used to set the stkqtyord and stkqtyship in order to update ICSW in stocking units. Content:

table_description: Value Add Entry Transaction Sections - Line Items
label: Usage

properties.Label: Usage
properties.Description: The usage flag is used to determine if usage in ICSWU should be updated for this line item. It is defaulted in the following manner: no - a labor product - a non-stock line - a special order item that is not an order as needed product - a stock product on a DO order yes - all other combinations The usage flag is overrideable on the line extended screen. (It is not overrideable on a labor product, non-stock product, lost business line, or core return). When the value add transaction section is completed, an ICET record is created. The ICET record contains a usagefl and mergedfl. ICAM uses ICET record to record used. If the ICET mergedfl = no and ICET usagefl = yes, ICAM will use this ICET record to record usage in ICSWU. properties.Description: WT Billed OE#. Once an order is auto generated for billing off the WT Transfer, the OE order that is created is stored in this field. Way to link the WT back to a specific Customer Owned OE Billing order. The OE order is not a standard sales order. It is just a bill to send the customer for the good transferred into the customer's stock. Content:

properties.Label: Billed OE Suf
properties.Description: See the description for autoaltordno - loaded at the same time and places. Content:

properties.Label: WT Billed Status
properties.Description: If a WT will be used to automatically generate an OE Order - WT Billed Order, then the field will carry a value. During receiving - WTEI, WLEBR, or WTEE, if a WT qualifies as a transfer for billing of customer owned inventory transfer, it flags the WT with 'O' for Open in this field. Once the WT is used to create the OE Order for billing of the transferred goods, the field value goes to 'B' for Billed if the order creates clean. If the WT contains a Non-Stock line item, the WT Billed status will be set to 'E'rror. Meaning, the Non Stock portion of the WT must be billed manually by someone. If the order does not meet the requirements - the field remains blank. See oeeh.autoaltwhsefl for edits of the WT to validate as a WT Billed Order. The WT can be set to 'B'illed as well from OEEPI when a normal sales line contains a line with AltWhse loaded. OEEPI will auto generate a WT and auto receive it. At that point, if set to use 'Bill and Hold' processing, then the WT is set to Billed and the OE is tied to the WT Header as the Billed OE#. Content:

properties.Label: Customer Cost
properties.Help: Customer Cost When the Customer Inventory is Shipped
properties.Description: Loads in WTES during the Final Update. If the Shipping Whse is Storeroom managed and there is stock available in that warehouse that is Customer Owned, then the new field is loaded with the Customer Cost off the ICSW record of the shipping whse. There is a setting at the Whse level to determine which cost to use in ICSW - Fixed Customer Cost or Average Customer Cost. The Cost loaded on the WT Line is used in WTEI for the Customer Owned quantity that is shipped to the receiving warehouse for ICETC updates, Customer Average Cost calculations, etc. Content:

properties.Label: Customer Stk Qty
properties.Help: How Much of the Inventory Shipped is Customer Owned
properties.Description: Loads in WTES during the Final Update. If the Shipping Whse is Storeroom managed and there is stock available in that warehouse that is Customer Owned, then the new field is loaded with what ever amount of the line's Stock Qty Shipped amount that it can (full amount, partial amount or none). The quantity loaded on the WT Line is used in WTEI for the Customer Owned quantity that is shipped to the receiving warehouse for ICETC updates, Customer Average Cost calculations, etc. It is a sub-set of the wtel.stkqtyship field - meaning this old field is still the full shipped quantity for the line item, and the new customer field reflects how much of the line quantity is customer owned when shipped.
